title: English Sales - Cold Calling
description:
We are looking for a Senior Business Development Representative to drive new business through outbound prospecting and cold calling. This is a phone-heavy role focused on identifying, qualifying, and converting leads into sales opportunities. The ideal candidate has at least 3 years of experience in outbound sales and thrives in high-volume calling environments. Payments will be sent monthly on the 5th of the following month.



Responsibilities:

- Execute 80–120+ outbound cold calls daily to prospective clients using provided and self-sourced lead lists.

- Qualify prospects by identifying pain points, budget, decision-making authority, and timeline (BANT or equivalent - framework).

- Deliver a clear, compelling pitch tailored to each prospect's industry and business needs.

- Overcome objections and handle rejection professionally to keep pipeline momentum.

- Schedule qualified meetings and product demos for Account Executives or close deals directly, depending on deal size.

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all prospect interactions in the CRM (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).

- Collaborate with marketing to refine messaging, provide feedback on lead quality, and improve targeting.

- Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly KPIs for calls made, conversations held, meetings booked, and revenue generated.

- Mentor junior SDRs/BDRs on call techniques, objection handling, and pipeline management.

- Stay current on industry trends, competitor offerings, and product updates to strengthen conversations.



Requirements:

- Minimum 3 years of experience in outbound sales, cold calling, or telemarketing in a B2B or B2C environment.

- Native or near-native English fluency (spoken and written) — this is non-negotiable.

- Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas and KPIs.

- Strong command of consultative selling, objection handling, and closing techniques.

- Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or equivalent).

- Comfortable with sales engagement tools (e.g., Outreach, SalesLoft, Apollo, or similar).

- Excellent active listening skills with the ability to adapt pitch in real time.

- Self-motivated, resilient, and able to maintain energy and professionalism through high rejection rates.

title: Web Designer
description:
About Hakkawise

Hakkawise is a multi-brand consumer goods group. Our brands run Shopify storefronts loved by our customers around the world – here we we own the customer relationship, build loyalty, and grow recurring revenue. This role owns how those sites look, feel, and perform.



The Role

We're looking for an experienced, ecommerce-native Web Designer to design and build high-performing Shopify storefronts across our brand portfolio. You'll turn brand identity into conversion-focused sites, implement the functionality that drives sales, and set up and maintain the subscription tools that power our recurring revenue. This is a hands-on role that blends design, ecommerce know-how, and technical fluency — with direct, visible impact on the top line.



What You'll Do

• Design and build Shopify storefronts: across our brands, translating brand identity into clean, conversion-focused ecommerce experiences.

• Implement ecommerce functionality: product pages, collections, checkout flows, upsells and cross-sells, promotions, and other features that drive sales and average order value.

• Set up and maintain subscription tools: configuring and managing customer subscription apps (e.g. Recharge, Loop, Skio) to grow and retain recurring revenue.

• Optimise for conversion and performance: improving page speed, mobile experience, and user journeys, informed by data and testing.

• Maintain and update live sites: managing changes, QA, and troubleshooting so storefronts stay fast, accurate, and on-brand.

• Work closely with marketing and brand teams: turning campaigns, launches, and promotions into effective on-site experiences.

What We're Looking For

• Proven experience designing and building Shopify ecommerce websites — ideally more than one live store.

• Strong understanding of ecommerce and the functionality a modern storefront needs (checkout, upsells, promotions, conversion drivers).

• Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining customer subscription tools (Recharge, Loop, Skio, or similar).

• Solid design skills and eye for detail — comfortable working in Figma and translating brand guidelines into polished, on-brand pages.

• Working knowledge of Shopify Liquid, HTML, and CSS (JavaScript a plus) to customise themes and functionality.

• Organised and self-directed, able to manage multiple brands and priorities without dropping quality.



Nice to Have

• Experience across multiple D2C brands or a multi-store setup.

• Familiarity with the wider Shopify app ecosystem - reviews, loyalty, and
/SMS tools (e.g. Klaviyo, Recharge).

• Basic design-for-brand or motion/graphic assets a bonus.

Rock M Roll / Pro Seller Marketing owns and launches consumer brands (DuoTrap, Whiff of Wow, ZenTropo) and runs an Amazon/Walmart agency. We are standing up DTC stores now while product hits our 3PL (FBA Fulfillment). DuoTrap inventory is shipping imminently.



THIS ROLE

You own our brand ecommerce stores and growth — not Amazon PPC (separate seat).

1. Named employers — agency OR large brand (we Google them). Title-only resumes = reject.

2. Active work in the last 24 months building or running live stores.

3. Shopify — collections, checkout, apps, launch experience.

4. WooCommerce / WordPress — can launch and maintain a converting store.

5. Paid acquisition — hands-on Google Ads AND at least one of Meta / TikTok ads for ecommerce.

6. Conversion mindset — offers, tracking (GA4/pixels), speed.

7. Claude or ChatGPT daily — describe a real workflow (not just the tool name).

8. Written English for SOPs and founder updates (ClickUp).



STRONG PLUS: GoHighLevel, Klaviyo, 3PL coordination, multi-brand agency, Canva/creative direction.



FIRST 30–60 DAYS

- Launch/rebuild stores for DuoTrap, Whiff of Wow, ZenTropo

- Domains, payments, shipping, 3PL workflows

- Tracking, pixels, GA4, basic CRO

- Google + paid social with weekly reporting

- Use Claude to move faster — human quality bar

- SOPs so we are not single-threaded



NOT THIS JOB: Pure Amazon PPC · pure VA · freelancers with no named brand/agency proof · "I can learn Shopify" with no launches.



HOURS / PAY

Full-time remote · Pacific overlap preferred. State your rate + hours. Paid trial week after interview.



HOW TO APPLY (follow or auto-reject)

A) Resume + portfolio links (live store URLs)

B) Named employers last 4 years + your seat

C) One paragraph: last store you launched or scaled (platform, traffic, result)

D) AI: one concrete Claude/ChatGPT weekly workflow

E) Rate + hours + earliest start

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (C# / Angular)
description:
About the Role



We are building a multi-tenant, n-tier SaaS platform and are looking for a strong full-stack engineer who thrives in 
 + Angular environments. You will work across the entire stack—designing clean domain models, implementing CQRS and messaging patterns, and delivering polished, responsive UIs—while deploying containerized services on Railway.



-Tech Stack

Backend: C# / .NET, Entity Framework Core, Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), CQRS, SOLID principles, JWT authentication

Frontend: Angular, Tailwind CSS

Data: PostgreSQL and/or SQL Server

Infrastructure: Containers (Docker), Railway

Architecture: N-tier, messaging architecture, functional programming influences

Security: Modern security practices, OWASP guidelines



What You’ll Do:

-Design and implement domain models, aggregates, value objects, and application services following Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design, and SOLID principles

-Build CQRS command/query handlers and integrate messaging patterns for reliable, decoupled communication

-Implement secure authentication and authorization using JWT, following modern security best practices and OWASP recommendations

-Develop and maintain Angular frontends with Tailwind, focusing on responsive, maintainable, and performant UIs

Work with Entity Framework Core against PostgreSQL and/or SQL Server, including multi-tenant considerations

-Containerize services and deploy/manage them on Railway

-Collaborate on API design, background processing, and overall system architecture

-Write clean, testable code with a preference for functional programming techniques where they improve clarity and correctness





Requirements

-Strong professional experience with C# and 

-Hands-on experience with Angular and component-based frontend development

-Solid understanding of Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design, CQRS, and SOLID principles

-Experience implementing JWT-based authentication and modern security practices (including awareness of OWASP Top 10)

-Experience with Entity Framework Core and relational databases (PostgreSQL and/or SQL Server)

-Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and cloud/PaaS deployment (Railway or similar)

-Comfort with messaging architectures (e.g., queues, events, pub/sub patterns)

-Ability to apply functional programming concepts in C# (immutability, pure functions, composition, etc.)

-Experience building or contributing to n-tier / multi-layer applications



Nice to Have

-Tailwind CSS experience

-Multi-tenant SaaS experience

-Background jobs / hosted services 

-GraphQL or OpenAPI experience

-Prior work with Railway or similar platforms

-Experience with additional auth patterns (e.g., refresh tokens, cookie + bearer dual auth)

-iOS / Android experience (native or cross-platform) is a plus





How to Apply

-On your subject line, please include the word "Golden Circle" so we know you read the job post

-Send a link to your resume and a short note about a relevant project/portfolio (especially anything involving Clean Architecture, CQRS, SOLID, JWT security, or Angular + .NET)



We're looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator
description:
Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator



**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 7:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Eastern Time

**Location:** Remote



About the Role



We are looking for a highly organized, responsive **Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator** to support our Parts and Supply Chain operations. This role serves as a key point of contact for parts customers while helping keep estimates, payments, Parts Research requests, purchase orders, and order updates moving forward.



You’ll be responsible for the day-to-day follow-through that creates a great customer experience and gives our internal Supply Chain team more time to focus on purchasing, sourcing, technical research, inventory, and complex procurement needs.



## What You’ll Do



* Answer inbound parts calls,
s, and assigned leads.

* Gather customer and equipment information, including make/model, serial numbers, data tags, photos, quantities, and requested parts.

* Create and maintain accurate customer and lead records.

* Coordinate requests requiring technical identification with our internal Parts Research team.

* Create and send parts estimates using approved information.

* Follow up consistently on open estimates through sale or closure.

* Communicate pricing, availability, and lead times to customers.

* Send payment links or instructions and follow up on routine outstanding payments.

* Create clear handoffs to Supply Chain when parts are ready to be ordered or shipped.

* Follow up on open purchase orders and vendor acknowledgments.

* Maintain accurate expected ship dates, lead times, backorder/delay information, and tracking details.

* Keep customers and internal teams informed throughout the process.

* Proactively flag delays, exceptions, or issues requiring additional support.



## What Success Looks Like



You are responsive, organized, and consistent. Customers receive timely communication, estimates don’t fall through the cracks, open orders have clear status updates, and internal teams can quickly determine where an order stands.



Key performance expectations include:



* **95%+** compliance with inbound customer response standards

* **98%+** compliance with required parts estimate follow-up

* **95%+** compliance with open purchase order visibility requirements



## What This Role Does Not Own

This role supports procurement and order coordination but does **not** independently make purchasing, sourcing, pricing, or technical parts-identification decisions. Complex vendor issues, inventory management, physical receiving/shipping, and other procurement exceptions remain with the internal Supply Chain team.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is:



* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable communicating with customers by phone and

* Consistent with follow-up and task management

* Able to manage multiple open requests without losing track of details

* Proactive about communicating delays and next steps

* Comfortable working across multiple systems and maintaining accurate records

* Team-oriented and able to coordinate effectively with Sales, Service, and Supply Chain

* Able to work consistently during **7:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Eastern Time**



This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys customer service, coordination, organization, and keeping processes moving from initial request through completion.

title: AI Automation Specialist (GoHighLevel + AI Chatbots)
description:
JOB TITLE: AI Automation Specialist (GoHighLevel + AI Chatbots+ Closebot)



TYPE OF WORK: Full Time



HOURS PER WEEK: 40



ABOUT THE ROLE



We build and deploy AI powered chatbots and automation systems inside GoHighLevel for businesses. We are looking for someone who can take a system from idea to live and working without needing constant direction.



You will be the first hire on the team, working directly with the founder. This is a hands on, builder role. You will spend most of your time inside GoHighLevel and AI tools, building conversation flows, connecting automations, and fixing what breaks before the client ever sees it.



This is not a generic VA role. We need someone who already knows how to build inside GoHighLevel and is comfortable working with AI conversation tools.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Build and manage AI conversation bots inside GoHighLevel

Set up and troubleshoot Conversation AI workflows for client accounts

Build automations, workflows, pipelines, and triggers inside GoHighLevel

Connect AI tools and third party platforms using APIs and webhooks

Test every system before it goes live and fix what does not work

Monitor live bots and automations and troubleshoot issues quickly

Document what you build so it can be maintained and handed off

Communicate clearly on progress, blockers, and what you need from us



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Real hands on experience inside GoHighLevel, not just the basics

Experience building or managing AI chatbots or conversation agents

Comfortable troubleshooting automations and finding what broke

Experience with workflows, triggers, pipelines, and custom fields

Comfortable with APIs, webhooks, and connecting tools that were not built to talk to each other

Self directed. You can solve problems without being told every step

Clear written English so we can communicate fast



NICE TO HAVE



Experience with n8n, Make, or Zapier

Basic understanding of AI prompt writing or prompt engineering

Experience with Claude, ChatGPT, or similar AI tools

Background in credit repair, sales, or client facing service businesses



HOW WE HIRE



We start with a short paid trial project before committing to a long term role. This lets us both see if it is a good fit before going further.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a generic application. To show me you read this post, start your reply with the word "Builder" at the top.



Then include



A short list of what you have built inside GoHighLevel and what it did

An example of an AI chatbot or automation you built, with screenshots or a Loom video if possible

Your availability and timezone

Your expected hourly rate



Applications that follow these steps will be reviewed first. Applications without examples of real work will not be considered.

title: Backend Manager — Fashion Ecommerce Brand (Full Ownership of Customer Service Ops, Backend Operations))
description:
Work Type: Part-time to start, scaling to full-time Reports To: Store Owner (you'll work directly with me — no layers in between) Industry: Fashion Ecommerce



About the Role



I run a fashion ecommerce store and I'm looking for an A-player Backend Manager who can take full ownership of customer service — end-to-end — so I never have to touch a support ticket again. This isn't a "help out with tickets" role. You'll be building and managing a team, owning escalations personally, and running the process like it's your own business.



If you're someone who gets bored managing a single agent and wants to build and run a real team from day one, this is for you.



What You'll Own

Team & Hiring

Build and manage a customer service team of VAs/agents — you'll start with at least 2 VAs from day one, not just one

Source and interview new VA candidates, record the interview calls, and send me a summary for approval

Final hiring decisions stay with me, but you run the entire process up to that point

Structure shifts across time zones so ticket coverage runs 24 hours

Run daily check-ins with your team to keep them accountable

Daily Operations

Personally handle or oversee ticket volume — first response and resolution across the whole team

Handle escalations personally, including calling customers directly for "heavy" tickets like chargebacks

Coordinate directly with the Supply Chain Manager whenever a CS issue traces back to a supply problem

Work through a dedicated business
 and get invited into our CS software (e.g. Gorgias, Reamaze) through it — no personal inbox access

Monitor chargeback rates closely and take action to keep them low

Keep customer satisfaction (CSAT) high across the team's interactions

Track and minimize refund and chargeback volume — you own these numbers, not just the tickets

Process & Reporting

Build workflows, macros, escalation rules, and SOP documentation instead of solving the same issue over and over

Report to me quickly during working hours (fast response window expected); send a daily status update

Proactively flag process improvements and better tools rather than just reacting to problems

Daily check-ins with me in week one for unlimited questions, then you operate independently

After that, just a short weekly check-in (~1 hour) to confirm everything's on track

Who You Are

You've managed a customer service team before (not just worked tickets solo) — ideally in ecommerce

You can hire, train, and hold people accountable without me having to manage the managers

You're comfortable being the final word on escalated, high-stakes customer issues, including calling customers directly

You document everything — SOPs, macros, workflows — because you hate solving the same problem twice

You're proactive: you flag problems and bring solutions, not just status reports

You're organized enough to run 24-hour coverage across time zones without dropping the ball

Experience with helpdesk tools like Gorgias or Reamaze is a strong plus

What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days, I should be able to stop thinking about customer service entirely. Tickets get handled fast, escalations get resolved without needing me, chargeback rates and refund volume trend down, customer satisfaction stays high, and I get a clear daily/weekly pulse on what's happening — without being pulled into the weeds.



How to Apply



Please include in your application:



A short summary of a CS team you've built or managed, and its size

An example of an SOP, macro, or workflow you've created to solve a recurring issue

How you'd structure a 2-person VA team to cover 24-hour ticket coverage across time zones

Your available start date and whether you're looking for part-time or full-time work initially



Applications without these will not be considered — I'm looking for someone who reads instructions carefully, since that's exactly what this role requires.

title: E-commerce Meta Ads Video Editor — Long-Term Position
description:
We are looking for an experienced **video editor to create high-performing Meta ads** for our Dutch e-commerce pet brand, **Dierenhome**.



We provide the **hooks, complete scripts, product information, examples and creative direction**.



Your job is **not to write the scripts or come up with the hooks**. Your job is to take the scripts we provide and turn them into complete, engaging
 and Instagram video advertisements.



A very important part of this role is **speed and efficiency**.



We are not looking for someone who spends hours trying to make every video cinematic or overly polished. These are **direct-response Meta ads**, and our goal is to test creatives quickly while making sure the story and message of each script come across clearly.



A simple video with the right footage, strong pacing and a clear story is often better than an over-edited cinematic advertisement.



### You will be responsible for:



* Turning our provided scripts into complete Meta video ads

* Producing video ads **quickly and efficiently**

* Finding relevant product footage, stock footage and supporting B-roll

* Choosing visuals that clearly match each part of the script

* Making sure the **story and main message of the script are easy to understand**

* Making the hook we provide visually strong in the first few seconds

* Adding subtitles, music, sound effects and visual elements where needed

* Editing with strong pacing and a clear direct-response structure

* Knowing when to keep an edit simple instead of over-editing it

* Asking us for additional product footage or B-roll when necessary

* Creating different editing variations for creative testing

* Delivering videos on time and correctly following feedback



We do **not** want an editor who simply puts random footage underneath a voice-over.



You need to understand what each part of the script is communicating and select footage that helps tell that story.



For example, if our script talks about a problem pet owners experience, the footage should clearly communicate that problem. When the script introduces our product as the solution, the visuals should clearly demonstrate the product and its benefits.



You do **not** need to create the marketing angle, hook or script yourself — **we provide these**.



Your responsibility is to make sure our idea is translated into a strong video ad.



### What we value



**Speed**



We test a high volume of creatives, so you need to be able to edit videos quickly and efficiently. We do not expect every ad to be cinematic.



**Clear storytelling**



The footage should support our script. Every scene should have a reason for being there and help the viewer understand the message.



**Direct-response editing**



You should understand pacing, retention and how Meta ads are structured. Your editing should support the hook and keep the viewer engaged throughout the video.



**Good judgement**



Not every advertisement needs complicated animations, transitions or effects. Sometimes simple UGC footage, B-roll and good pacing are exactly what is needed.



**Independent footage selection**



Once you receive our script, you should be able to independently d
 what type of footage is needed and find suitable footage yourself.



If important product footage is missing, we expect you to tell us what you need so we can provide it.



### Requirements:



* Experience editing e-commerce, Meta or TikTok advertisements

* Understanding of pacing, retention and direct-response advertising

* Ability to work **quickly without sacrificing clarity**

* Ability to independently find suitable footage and B-roll

* Ability to correctly interpret written scripts

* Good English communication

* Strong attention to detail

* Reliable and able to meet deadlines

* Open to feedback and revisions

* Able to ask questions when footage or information is missing

* Comfortable producing multiple video ads and variations for testing



This is a **long-term monthly position**.



When the collaboration works well, you will receive consistent work and the number of videos can increase over time.



We are looking for someone who can become a reliable part of our creative production process and help us produce a **high volume of Meta ads efficiently**.



### To apply, please send:



1. A short introduction

2. Three of your best e-commerce or Meta ad examples

3. The editing software you use

4. Your average turnaround time per video

5. Approximately how many video ads you can realistically edit per working day



Start your application with the word **DIERENHOME** so we know you have read the full job description.

title: AI Video Ad Creative Assistant / AI Video Ads Producer
description:
We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented assistant to help us create AI-generated video ads for social media platforms like TikTok, Meta, YouTube Shorts, and Reels.



This role is for someone who can help with the full AI video ad creation process, from researching ad ideas and hooks, to creating avatars, writing prompts, generating video clips, organizing files, and preparing final video ad variations for testing.



Our ads are often created for non-English markets, but strong English is the key skill for this role. Most of the creative work, instructions, prompts, research, and communication will be done in English. Scripts can be translated and refined using AI tools, and final script approval will be done by us.



You must be very comfortable working with AI tools and have a strong sense for what makes a good direct-response video ad.



## Main Responsibilities



You will help with tasks such as:



* Researching ad ideas, hooks, formats, and competitor examples

* Coming up with new video ad concepts and angles

* Creating AI avatars / personas for ads

* Creating realistic AI image prompts for characters, settings, and scenes

* Creating AI video prompts for tools like Veo 3.1, HeyGen, Synthesia, ElevenLabs, CapCut, or similar tools

* Turning scripts into short video scenes or clips

* Creating multiple variations of winning ads, for example new hooks, new avatars, new settings, or new scenarios

* Translating and refining scripts with AI tools when needed

* Organizing all creatives, scripts, prompts, avatars, and versions clearly

* Preparing videos for social media ad testing

* Helping build a repeatable AI video ad production workflow



## What We Are Looking For



You should be:



* Strong in written English

* Very comfortable using AI tools, including tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar

* Creative and able to come up with many ad ideas quickly

* Detail-oriented and organized

* Good at following instructions and improving based on feedback

* Able to understand why some ads perform better than others

* Interested in direct-response marketing, paid ads, UGC ads, and short-form video ads

* Able to work independently after training

* Willing to test, iterate, and improve creative concepts



## Nice to Have



Experience with any of the following is a big plus:



* AI video tools like kie.ai, Veo 3.1, Kling, Runway, Pika, HeyGen, Synthesia, etc.

* AI image tools like Midjourney, ChatGPT image generation, Leonardo, Ideogram, etc.

* AI writing tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar

* CapCut or other video editing tools

* TikTok /
 / Instagram ad creatives

* UGC-style video ads

* Direct-response copywriting

* Experience adapting ads for non-English markets



## Important



This is not just a simple video editing job. We are looking for someone who can become part of our creative production process and eventually take over large parts of the AI ad creation workflow.



You do not need to be an expert on day one, but you must be smart, curious, creative, and willing to learn fast.



## Example Tasks



Here are some examples of tasks you may receive:



* “Create 5 new hook ideas for this video ad.”

* “Generate 3 different avatar concepts for this ad angle.”

* “Turn this script into 8-second video scenes.”

* “Create a video prompt for each scene.”

* “Make this character look more realistic and less polished.”

* “Create a new ad variation using the same script but a different setting.”

* “Organize these winning ads and label the hook, avatar, angle, and format.”

* “Find 10 examples of UGC-style ads and summarize what angles they use.”

3. Have you worked on TikTok,
, Instagram, or YouTube ad creatives before?

7. What is your current availability per week?

8. What is your expected monthly salary or hourly rate?



Please start your application with the words: **AI VIDEO CREATIVE**

title: VA- PE / Independent Sponsor Target List Building
description:
Researcher needed to build a targeted B2B prospect list of private equity firms and independent sponsors that have RECENTLY ACQUIRED a company (last 0–120 days). You'll monitor deal announcements, qualify firms against simple rules, and find contact info for 1–2 people per firm. Detail matters more than speed. ~5–8 hrs/week, 6 weeks, likely ongoing for the right person. Please include the word "flywheel" in your application so I know you read this.



What the VA does weekly

Find recent deals (the trigger): Google Alerts results I'll share + searching: "completes acquisition," "platform investment," "recapitalization," "announces acquisition of" (past 30 days); LinkedIn posts "excited to announce the acquisition"; PE Hub / Axios Pro Rata newsletters; SearchFunder closed-deal posts (I'll provide login/screenshots).

Qualify the acquirer — INCLUDE if: independent/fundless sponsor (any size), OR PE firm with roughly 2–50 employees and ~3–15 portfolio companies listed on its site, OR family office doing direct deals. Acquired company looks like $2M–$50M revenue B2B (services, distribution, manufacturing, home services).

EXCLUDE if: firm >$1B AUM or >50 employees; website shows a "Data & Analytics" or "Digital" team; VC firm; acquirer is a public company or large strategic; deal older than 120 days.

Find contacts (1–2 per firm), in priority order: Operating Partner ? Head/VP of Portfolio Operations ? the Principal/VP named in the deal announcement ? Founder/Managing Partner (always the contact for sponsors).
 via 
/Apollo free tier or pattern-matching; flag confidence Low/Med/High. LinkedIn URL required.

title: Investor Relations Manager
description:
About the Role



We're looking for a sharp, highly organized Investor Relations Manager to own and grow our investor network. You'll be the main point of contact for the investors we work with — keeping them engaged, onboarded, informed, and aligned — while constantly expanding the network with new, high-quality investors.



This is a relationship-driven role. You need flawless communication, strong attention to detail, and the ability to run structured processes (interviews, contracts, onboarding) without letting anything slip through the cracks.



What You'll Be Doing



• Manage our investor network: be the day-to-day point of contact for all investors in our network and keep relationships warm and healthy

• Book investor calls: schedule and coordinate calls between investors and our team, managing calendars and follow-ups

• Collect investor feedback: proactively gather feedback from investors and document it clearly

• Grow the network: source and add new investors — running the job posts / outreach, screening applicants, and conducting interviews

• Contracts: prepare, send, and track contracts through to signature

• Onboarding: run a smooth, professional onboarding process so every new investor is set up correctly from day one

• Internal alignment: share investor feedback with our Account Manager / CSM and interface with them daily to ensure clean alignment at all times

Who We're Looking For

• Perfect written and spoken English — you'll be representing us directly to investors, so communication must be polished and professional

• Highly organized and process-driven — you can juggle interviews, contracts, onboarding, and follow-ups without dropping the ball

• Confident on calls — comfortable interviewing new investors and holding professional conversations

• Hyper-responsive — you reply to investors and to the team in minutes, not hours

• Go-getter mentality — you take initiative, spot problems, and fix them before anyone has to ask

• A genuine passion for online business and investing — you're curious about the space and want to grow with us

• Experience in investor relations, client success, recruiting, or account management is a big plus

• Experience with tools like Google Workspace, Calendly, DocuSign/PandaDoc, and CRMs is a big plus



What We Offer



• Long-term, stable full-time role

• Work directly with the founder and leadership team in a growing online business

• A high-trust seat with real ownership over a core part of the business

• Room to grow into higher-paying roles as we scale

title: Legal Technology & Automation Analyst (MCA Recovery Operations)
description:
About the Industry:

Our Company is a boutique commercial enforcement and receivables-servicing firm specializing in the recovery of defaulted Merchant Cash Advance (MCA) receivables for funders nationwide. Working alongside partner law firms with multi-state UCC enforcement and MCA litigation practices, our work spans the full enforcement lifecycle: UCC Article 9 lien notices and payment redirects, restraining notices and bank/merchant account restraints, confessions of judgment, post-judgment enforcement (levies, turnovers, debtor examinations, judgment domestication), and bankruptcy proofs of claim.



What sets us apart is our technology. We run our operations on a custom-built case platform, automated document generation, AI-assisted intake and target identification, and integrated financial reporting and we're expanding the team that builds and maintains it.



The Role:

We are seeking a Legal Technology & Automation Analyst to develop and maintain the systems that power our enforcement operations. You will sit at the intersection of financial reporting, case management, and software development building the tools our recovery, lien, and settlement teams use every day.



This is a hands on builder role. You should be equally comfortable debugging a VBA macro in a client reporting workbook, wiring a REST API integration into our case management system, and prototyping an AI-assisted workflow for document extraction or entity research.



Key Responsibilities:

Excel & Financial Reporting Engineering:

- Maintain and develop the firm's Excel workbooks for financial and client reporting, including complex formula architectures, VBA modules, and macros.

- Build and refine payment ledgers, NET DUE reports, portfolio dashboards, and recovery reconciliation models.

- Harden workbooks against user error; document logic so reporting survives personnel changes and audits.



API Integration & Platform Development:

- Design and build API integrations for our case management system (Simplicity Collect / ServiceStack API), covering automated account intake, status sync, and reporting extracts.

- Integrate payment processor APIs for payment posting, plan monitoring, and exception flagging.

- Develop and maintain integrations between our website, intake forms, and internal platform.

- Support our internal web platform (Cloudflare Workers/Pages, Airtable backend) with feature slices, data pipelines, and reporting endpoints.



AI Tool Development:

- Assist in developing and refining AI-assisted workflows: document extraction from purchase agreements, UCC-1 filings, and bank statements; target and registered-agent identification; lien notice package generation.

- Build, test, and document AI skills, prompts, and automation pipelines used by the recovery and intake teams.

- Evaluate new AI tooling and propose adoption where it measurably improves throughput or accuracy.



Enforcement Operations Support:

- Translate legal-team requirements (lien notices, restraining notices, settlement documents, litigation and post-judgment workflows) into structured data models, templates, and automations.

- Support attorneys, paralegals, and recovery specialists with data pulls, batch document generation, and case reporting for litigation and settlement purposes.

- Maintain audit-ready documentation of systems, integrations, and data flows.



Requirements:

- 3+ years of experience in a technical operations, financial systems, litigation support, or software development role.

- Advanced Excel: complex formulas, VBA, and macro development for production financial reporting not just power-user proficiency. Be prepared to walk through workbooks you've built.

- API integration experience*: REST APIs, authentication flows, JSON payloads, and error handling; comfort reading API documentation and shipping working integrations.

- Working proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language (JavaScript/TypeScript or Python preferred).

- Hands-on experience with AI/LLM tools beyond casual use — prompt engineering, workflow automation, or building on LLM APIs.

- Strong data hygiene instincts: validation, reconciliation, version control, and documentation discipline.

- Ability to work with legal and collections professionals, translating operational needs into technical specifications.



Preferred:

- Experience with collections platforms (Simplicity Collect strongly preferred), CRMs, or legal case management systems.

- Familiarity with Cloudflare Workers/Pages, Airtable, or comparable low-ops web stacks.

- Exposure to MCA, commercial collections, receivables, or legal enforcement workflows (UCC liens, judgments, garnishments) — training provided on the legal side.

- Experience with payment processing systems (ACH, card processing, merchant accounts).

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or related field or equivalent demonstrated work.



What We Offer:

title: Creative Strategist – Direct Response / Paid Social
description:
Full-Time | Remote | $1,500-$2,500 USD/month + Performance Upside



====================

ABOUT THE ROLE

==============



We are looking for an experienced Creative Strategist to take ownership of creative strategy for a growing portfolio of direct-response brands.



Our current brands operate primarily in the manifestation, spirituality and personal development space, with additional related brands planned.



We are heavily focused on paid acquisition through platforms such as Meta and TikTok.



This is a long-term role for someone who wants to become deeply involved in the brands they work on and ultimately take responsibility for the entire creative strategy function.



====================

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

=====================



Ideally, you have previous experience working with a direct-response brand.



If not, you should at minimum have strong experience creating performance advertising for an e-commerce brand where creative was directly measured against paid advertising results.



We are NOT looking for someone whose experience is mainly:



* Organic social media

* Content calendars

* Branding

* General social media management

* Making visually attractive content without responsibility for performance



You should already understand the cycle:



CREATIVE -> SPEND -> DATA -> LEARNINGS -> NEW CREATIVE



We want someone who thinks in terms of angles, hooks, customer psychology, testing, CPA, ROAS and conversion rather than simply producing content.



====================

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

=================



We already have video editors.



Your job is not primarily to edit videos yourself.

Your job is to focus and choose on:



WHAT SHOULD WE CREATE?



WHY SHOULD WE CREATE IT?



WHAT SHOULD WE DO NEXT BASED ON THE RESULTS?



You will eventually take ownership of the creative process from research through production, testing and iteration.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Deeply understanding our customers and markets

* Researching competitors and adjacent niches

* Studying our historical winning and losing creatives

* Identifying why certain ads perform

* Finding new angles, hooks, stories, personas, mechanisms and formats

* Developing complete creative concepts

* Writing direct-response scripts

* Creating clear briefs for video editors

* Giving visual direction and examples where needed

* Managing our video editors and their production queue

* Reviewing drafts and providing actionable feedback

* Maintaining a consistent creative production pipeline

* Building structured creative testing plans

* Choosing what hypotheses should be tested next

* Analyzing creative performance after launch

* Identifying patterns across winners and losers

* Iterating aggressively on winning concepts

* Developing completely new concepts rather than endlessly remixing old winners

* Identifying creative fatigue

* Working closely with media buying on testing, scaling and creative priorities

* Building systems that improve the speed and quality of our creative operation



We don't want to tell you every week which ads we think should be made.



Over time, we want YOU to bring that plan to us.



====================

DIRECT-RESPONSE THINKING

========================



Performance creative isn't about making the prettiest advertisement.



It's about understanding why people take action.



When one creative has a $30 CPA and another has a $60 CPA, you should naturally start asking why.



Was it:



* The hook?

* The angle?

* The persona?

* The story?

* The first few seconds?

* The mechanism?

* The level of awareness?

* The credibility?

* The pacing?

* The CTA?

* The offer positioning?



Then you should be able to turn those observations into the NEXT SET OF CREATIVE TESTS.



We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys this process.



====================

PERFORMANCE DATA

================



You do not need to be our primary media buyer.



However, you need to understand paid advertising well enough to use performance data to make creative decisions and work closely with media buying.



You should be comfortable analyzing metrics such as:



* CPA

* ROAS

* CTR

* CPC

* CPM

* Conversion Rate

* Hook / Thumb-Stop Rate

* Hold Rates

* Watch Time

* Landing Page Conversion Rate

* Funnel Conversion Rates



We don't want someone who simply reports numbers.



We want someone who uses those numbers to answer:



WHAT SHOULD WE CREATE NEXT?



====================

MANAGING THE CREATIVE TEAM

==========================



We already have video editors and expect the creative team to grow.



You will be responsible for directing their work, including:



* Choosing what should be produced

* Prioritizing creatives

* Writing clear briefs

* Assigning work

* Reviewing drafts

* Giving revisions and feedback

* Maintaining quality

* Making sure creatives are delivered consistently

* Helping improve the team over time



You should be comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for instructions.



====================

RESEARCH

========



Research will be a major part of your job.



You should constantly be looking for new insights, patterns and ideas across:



* TikTok

* Meta Ad Library

* YouTube

* Reddit

* Competitors

* Adjacent markets

* Viral organic content

* Customer comments

* Reviews

* Landing pages

* Advertorials

* Sales pages

* Historical creatives

* Creative performance data



We want someone who naturally sees a successful advertisement and starts wondering:



WHY DOES THIS WORK?



And then:



HOW CAN WE USE THE UNDERLYING PRINCIPLE IN OUR OWN WAY?



====================

AI

==



We use AI heavily and expect it to become an even bigger part of our creative operation.



We currently use AI across areas such as:



* Research

* Copywriting

* Translation and localization

* Image generation

* Video generation

* Avatars

* Voice generation

* Ideation

* Creative analysis



You don't need to know every tool we currently use.



You do need to be comfortable learning new tools quickly and figuring things out.



====================

LANGUAGE

========



Our internal working language is English.



Some of our current advertising runs in non-English-speaking markets, but you do NOT need to speak those languages.



We use translation, localization and AI throughout our creative process.



We are also actively expanding into English-speaking markets.



Strong English communication and strong marketing instincts are much more important to us than speaking any specific additional language.



====================

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

=======================



At the beginning, you will spend significant time learning our brands, customers, historical creatives and advertising data.



Over time, we want you to be able to come to us and say:



"Here's what we learned.



Here are the biggest creative opportunities I see.



Here are the hypotheses I want to test.



Here are the creatives we're producing next.



Here's what the editors are working on.



And here's how I think we should test them."



We want someone who eventually knows our brands extremely well.



Someone who knows the customer.



Someone who knows our winners and our losers.



Someone who knows what competitors are doing.



Someone who is always thinking about the next opportunity.



We want you to eat, sleep and breathe these brands.



As we launch additional brands, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of their creative strategy as well.



====================

COMPENSATION

============



$1,500-$2,500 USD per month depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



We are willing to pay toward the top of that range for someone with strong direct-response experience who can genuinely take ownership of this function.



There is also potential for meaningful performance-based bonuses and/or profit participation for the right person.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a core, long-term member of the company.



This is not a short freelance project.



The more responsibility you can take and the more value you create, the greater the opportunity becomes.



====================

HOW TO APPLY

============



Please do NOT send us a generic cover letter.



Start your application with:



CREATIVE GROWTH



Then answer these four questions:



1. DIRECT-RESPONSE EXPERIENCE



Tell us about your direct-response or e-commerce creative experience.



Which brands or types of brands have you worked with?



What were they selling, which advertising platforms did you work on, and what were you personally responsible for?



If you know the approximate monthly ad spend of the brands you worked with, please include it.



2. SHOW US YOUR WORK



Send us 2-3 paid ads you personally strategized or played a major role in creating.



For each one, briefly explain:



* The idea or angle behind it

* What you personally contributed

* How it performed, if you have the data

* What you did with the learnings afterward



We care much more about how you think than seeing a huge portfolio.



3. YOU FIND A WINNER. WHAT NEXT?



One of your ads suddenly becomes the clear winner.



What do you do next?



Keep your answer practical.



We want to understand how you think about analyzing, iterating and scaling winning creative.



4. TEAM MANAGEMENT



Have you managed video editors or other creative team members before?



If yes, briefly explain what you managed and how the workflow worked.



====================

HIRING PROCESS

==============



Strong applicants will be invited to a Google Meet interview so we can learn more about your experience and how you approach creative strategy.



Final candidates may then be invited to complete a paid creative strategy exercise using one of our actual brands.



We care much more about how you think, what you've actually done and whether you can take ownership than how impressive your resume looks.



If you have real performance marketing experience, love advertising psychology, enjoy figuring out why people buy and want to take ownership of creative growth across multiple brands, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Virtual Assistant — SEO/AEO/GEO Specialist (AI Agent Trainer)
description:
## About the Role



We run a portfolio of businesses operated largely by AI agents. We are hiring an experienced search optimization specialist whose job is not to do SEO manually — it is to **teach our AI agents how to do it**. You will document your knowledge as step-by-step processes (SOPs), train the agent through examples and feedback, review its output, and refine its instructions until it optimizes websites, blog posts, and user-generated content with minimal human input.



The scope covers all three layers of modern search:

- **SEO** — classic organic search optimization

- **AEO** — answer engine optimization (featured snippets, People Also Ask)

- **GEO** — generative engine optimization (getting content cited and recommended by Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity)



## What You'll Do



- Design the end-to-end optimization workflow (keyword/topic research ? content briefs ? on-page optimization ? technical checks ? AEO/GEO tactics ? measurement) as clear, written SOPs an AI agent can follow

- Train the agent by reviewing its optimized drafts, briefs, and audit outputs — approving, correcting, and explaining your reasoning

- Set quality standards: what a well-optimized page looks like, what fails, and why

- Build pass/fail checklists for technical SEO, on-page rules, and AI-answer visibility

- Define how to optimize UGC (reviews, community content, UGC-style posts) for search and AI answers

- Monitor results and translate learnings into updated agent instructions



## Required Experience



- 3+ years of hands-on SEO with provable ranking results (your own sites or clients')

- Working knowledge of AEO and GEO: featured snippets, structured data/schema, entity and E-E-A-T signals, and current tactics for visibility in AI-generated answers

- Daily fluency with Google Search Console and GA4, plus at least one of Ahrefs, Semrush, or comparable tools

- Solid technical SEO: indexing, Core Web Vitals, schema, site structure

- Excellent written English — this role is mostly writing instructions and feedback

- Comfortable working with AI tools; you can't be afraid of AI — you'll be teaching one



## Nice to Have



- Experience optimizing UGC-heavy sites (reviews, forums, communities) or short-form content for search

- Experience writing SOPs or training other team members

- Recovery experience from algorithm updates or ranking losses



## How We Work



Remote and mostly async. You'll communicate in written English via chat and short documents. Flexible hours with some overlap for check-ins.



---



## Application Questionnaire (required)



Please answer all questions in English. Short, specific answers beat long generic ones.



1. Describe your best provable ranking result: the site (or niche if confidential), starting point, what you did, and the outcome. Link public evidence if available.

2. Walk us through your keyword research process step by step, naming the exact tool you use at each step.

3. AEO/GEO: what concrete tactics have you used to win featured snippets or get content cited by AI Overviews/ChatGPT/Perplexity? Name specifics.

4. What are the first 5 technical checks you run on a site you've never seen, and with which tools?

5. Describe a time a site you worked on lost rankings (algorithm update or otherwise). What did you diagnose and change?

6. Imagine you must teach a very literal-minded new employee to optimize a blog post's title and H1. Write the exact rules you would give them (5–10 lines).

title: Systems Administrator
description:
PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR RESUME LINK



Job description:



Systems Administrator, Server & Infrastructure (Remote)

Tech Guru - IT for Accounting Firms

Why This Role Exists



At Tech Guru, we empower accounting firms with secure, high-performance IT that just works. As our Server & Infrastructure Systems Administrator, your mission is to own the reliability and security of the server, virtualization, and identity layers across our clients, all while living our core values of Caring, Accountable, Responsive, and Empathetic service.This is the deep-infrastructure seat.



You live in Windows Server, Hyper-V, RDS/AVD, Active Directory, and Entra ID, and you make sure the foundation everything else sits on never wobbles.



What Success Looks Like (Outcomes)



Near-Zero Server Downtime: Reduce critical server-side i
 for assigned clients to under 1 per quarter through proactive monitoring, scripting, and remediation.

Patch & Backup Assurance: Keep server patch compliance above 95 percent, verify backup success daily, and prove recoverability with tested restores and documented DR runbooks.

Healthy Virtualization Estate: Keep Hyper-V hosts and RDS/AVD session environments tuned, capacity-planned, and free of resource contention.

Hardened Foundation: Secure the server, Active Directory, and Entra layers to SOC 2 and FTC Safeguards expectations, with least-privilege and clean audit evidence.

Build Standardization: Design, document, and maintain gold images and deployment pipelines so server and session-host builds are repeatable and consistent.

Process Mastery: Create or update at least two Core Process documents each quarter, each simpler than its predecessor.

Day-to-day Responsibilities



Build, patch, monitor, and remediate Windows Server (2019, 2022, 2025) and Hyper-V hosts.

Administer Active Directory, Entra ID, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificate services, and file/print roles.

Stand up, tune, and troubleshoot RDS and Azure Virtual Desktop session farms (connection brokers, session hosts, profile management).

Own server backup and disaster recovery (Ninjaone backup), including periodic restore testing.

Design and maintain gold images and automated deployment strategy for server and session-host environments.

Manage Dell server hardware lifecycle: firmware, iDRAC, RAID, and warranty/health.

Resolve SQL connectivity and named-instance issues for accounting application stacks.

Investigate complex server-side escalations and coach frontline techs on prevention.

Generate concise, client-ready server health reports that feed quarterly business reviews.

Core Values in Action



Caring: You treat every server estate as if it were your own.

Accountable: You own uptime outcomes, celebrate wins, and learn fast from misses.

Responsive: You communicate early and often, never leaving teammates or clients guessing.

Empathetic: You remember that behind every host is a firm trying to serve its clients.

Must-have Qualifications



5+ years administering Windows Server in an MSP or similar high-volume environment.

Hyper-V management including command-line and PowerShell scripting.

Strong Active Directory and Entra ID administration: GPO, DNS, DHCP, certificates.

Proven PowerShell skills for build automation, patching, and reporting.

Hands-on RDS, terminal server, or AVD session-host experience.

Backup and DR experience with at least one of Datto, Cove, or equivalent.

Excellent spoken and written English, comfortable supporting US-based clients.

Nice to Have



Dell server and iDRAC experience, including troubleshooting via CLI.

SQL Server administration and connectivity troubleshooting.

Experience supporting accounting or other compliance-heavy industries.

Certifications such as AZ-104, MCSA/MCSE, or CompTIA Security+.

What We Offer



Fully remote.

Professional development and paid training.

Flexible schedule built on trust and outcomes, not timeclock punching.

A caring, values-driven culture that celebrates wins and supports life outside work.

Our DEI Pledge

Tech Guru is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where every tea
mber feels valued and empowered to contribute. We welcome applicants of any race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, socioeconomic background, disability status, or veteran status. If you share our passion for great IT and great people, we encourage you to apply, even if your resume does not tick every box



How to Apply

Upload your resume and a short cover letter on Indeed describing one measurable result you achieved by automating or standardizing a server or virtualization process.



Benefits:





Promotion to permanent employee

Work from home

What's your salary expectation?

Do you have a notice period?

Windows Server : 5 years (Required)

Hyper V : 3 years (Required)

Active Directory: 3 years (Required)

PowerShell: 2 years (Required)

Server Backup (Ninjaone Backup): 2 years (Required)

License/Certification:

title: Business Development Representative – US Recruitment Services
description:
Business Development Representative – US Recruitment Services



**Full-Time | Remote | US Hours | Long-Term Opportunity**



We are a growing UK-based recruitment company providing outsourced recruitment services to sales and marketing companies across the United States.



We are looking for an experienced **Business Development Representative** to help us grow our client base by identifying, connecting with, and building relationships with independent sales and marketing office owners across the US.



**Previous experience working within recruitment, staffing, lead generation, or a recruitment agency is highly preferred.**



This is **not a mass cold outreach role** where success means sending hundreds of generic messages every day.



We operate within a relationship-driven industry. We are looking for someone who can understand our target market, identify the right business owners, start genuine conversations, build relationships over time, and ultimately generate qualified meetings for our recruitment services.



The Role



Your primary objective will be to generate new business opportunities and book qualified meetings with owners of independent sales and marketing companies across the United States.



You will:



* Research and identify independent sales and marketing companies across the US

* Identify company owners, directors, and other key decision-makers

* Research prospects before making contact so outreach is personalised and relevant

* Connect with prospects through LinkedIn,
, telephone, social media, and other appropriate channels

* Build genuine relationships with office owners rather than relying solely on high-volume cold outreach

* Understand their current recruitment operation, hiring volume, challenges, and potential recruitment needs

* Maintain consistent follow-up with prospects over time

* Generate interest in our outsourced recruitment services

* Book qualified meetings with business owners who have a genuine potential need for our services

* Build and maintain an organised business development pipeline

* Keep accurate records of conversations, follow-ups, opportunities, and meetings

* Work closely with the company director to develop and improve our business development strategy

* Identify new companies, networks, and potential markets we should be targeting

* Help turn existing relationships and industry connections into new opportunities



This role will be measured primarily on the **quality of relationships and qualified meetings generated**, not simply the number of calls or messages sent.



Additional Business Development



We also operate **MyPathway**, our employee onboarding and retention platform.



As the role develops, you may also assist with generating new business opportunities for MyPathway.



This side of the role may involve more traditional B2B prospecting, including:



* Building targeted prospect lists

* Cold
 outreach

* LinkedIn outreach

* Cold calling

* Following up interested prospects

* Booking product demonstrations



Full training on both businesses and our target markets will be provided.



Essential Skills & Experience



We are looking for someone with:



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong B2B communication skills

* Previous business development, recruitment, appointment setting, or sales experience

* Confidence speaking directly with business owners and senior decision-makers

* Strong relationship-building skills

* Experience conducting prospect research

* Experience using LinkedIn for business development

* Experience with outbound calling and
 outreach

* Experience managing a sales pipeline or CRM

* Strong follow-up skills

* Excellent organisation and attention to detail

* Confidence working independently

* A commercial mindset and ability to recognise genuine business opportunities



Highly Desirable Experience



Preference will be given to candidates who have:



* Previously worked for a recruitment or staffing company

* Sold recruitment, staffing, HR, SaaS, or other B2B services

* Experience generating clients for recruitment agencies

* Experience speaking with US business owners

* Experience working with US companies

* Experience with relationship-based B2B sales

* Experience using HubSpot or similar CRM systems

* Experience with LinkedIn prospecting

* Experience booking qualified sales meetings

* Experience developing prospects over multiple conversations rather than relying only on immediate cold-call conversions



If you have previously helped a recruitment company win new clients, **we especially want to hear from you.**



What We're Looking For



This is not a basic virtual assistant or data-entry position.



We want someone who is commercially minded and genuinely understands **business development**.



The right person will know that not every prospect is ready to buy after the first message.



You should be comfortable starting conversations, remembering details about prospects, following up intelligently, staying in contact, and developing relationships until the right opportunity arises.



We would rather you build **20 valuable relationships with the right office owners than send 1,000 generic messages to the wrong people.**



You should be proactive enough to identify opportunities without waiting for a daily list of instructions.



Equipment & Internet Requirements



You must have:



* A modern laptop or desktop capable of running multiple business systems

* Stable high-speed internet

* A backup internet connection preferred

* A quiet, professional working environment for calls

* A quality headset and microphone

* Reliable power supply / backup preferred



Working Hours



* Full-time remote position

* Monday to Friday

* You must be comfortable working hours that overlap with **US business hours**

* Long-term position for the right person



Performance



The primary goal of this role is straightforward:



**Build relationships with the right US sales and marketing business owners and consistently generate qualified meetings that can become recruitment clients.**



We are interested in quality rather than vanity metrics.



Your performance will be based on factors including:



* Qualified meetings booked

* Quality of prospects generated

* Development of the prospect pipeline

* Follow-up consistency

* Relationships established with target office owners

* Ultimately, new business generated



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief summary of your previous business development experience.

2. Any experience you have working for a recruitment or staffing company.

3. Any experience you have generating clients for recruitment businesses.

4. Your experience working with US companies or US business owners.

5. The methods you have previously used to book B2B meetings.

6. An example of how you would approach an office owner who may already have an existing recruitment solution.

7. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

8. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.



**Please do not send a generic copy-and-paste application. We are specifically looking for someone who can demonstrate strong communication and relationship-building ability.**

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Instagram & Facebook)
description:
Everglow Miami is looking for a full-time remote video editor to own our short-form content pipeline for Instagram and
. You'll be turning raw in-office footage — talking-head clips, treatment b-roll, client transformations, and trend-based content — into scroll-stopping Reels that drive real consultation bookings.



This isn't a "cut it down and add captions" role. We want an editor who understands why a video holds attention: hook structure, pacing, retention curves, text placement, and what's currently working on the platform. If you watch a Reel and instinctively know why the first 1.5 seconds worked, you're who we're looking for.



What You'll Do

Edit 15–60+ second vertical videos for Instagram Reels and

Build motion graphics, animated text, transitions, and VFX in After Effects

Design hooks and opening frames that stop the scroll

Add captions, sound design, music syncing, and on-brand graphic overlays

Adapt trending formats, audio, and editing styles to our niche

Manage assets, versioning, and delivery on a consistent daily/weekly schedule

Communicate daily with our team during EST business hours and turn around revisions quickly

Requirements

After Effects experience is a must — this is non-negotiable

Proficiency in a primary editing NLE (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro)

Demonstrated experience editing short-form social content with a portfolio to back it up

Strong grasp of Instagram/Facebook best practices: aspect ratios, safe zones, caption styling, hook writing, retention pacing

Reliable high-speed internet and a machine that can handle AE renders without becoming a bottleneck

Start your application with the word 'compass' so we know you read the full posting

Available and responsive during the full 10 AM – 6 PM EST window, Monday through Friday

Fluent written English



Nice to Have

Experience in the med spa, aesthetics, healthcare, fitness, or wellness space

Before/after content editing experience

Photoshop or Illustrator for static assets and thumbnails

Basic copywriting for on-screen text and captions





Submit the following — applications missing any of these will not be reviewed:



Your resume, including previous editing experience and who you edited for

A list of every tool you use, split into two groups: tools you're proficient in and tools you're familiar with

A portfolio or reel link (Google Drive, Dropbox, Vimeo, YouTube, or Instagram) with at least 3 short-form videos you personally edited — tell us specifically what you did on each

Your After Effects experience: how long you've used it and one example in your portfolio where the AE work is visible

title: Adobe Illustrator Brand Identity Designer – Editable Logo System
description:
## Adobe Illustrator Brand Identity Designer – Editable Logo System



I am looking for an experienced **Adobe Illustrator / brand identity designer** to professionally rebuild an existing approved logo into a clean, precise, fully editable vector brand system.



**This is not a request for a new logo or redesign.** I already have the approved visual direction and will provide the reference artwork privately to shortlisted candidates. I need someone with strong Illustrator skills who can manually reconstruct it accurately, correct the typography and vector geometry, and organize everything into a professional master file that can be reused across multiple related brands.



The base identity is **Cloud IX**, with current and planned versions including:



* Cloud IX Luxury

* Cloud IX Properties

* Cloud IX Exotics



The core Cloud IX emblem and wordmark must remain consistent while the business descriptor can be changed easily.



### What I Need



The finished system will include:



* A manually constructed vector cloud/emblem

* A refined serif CLOUD IX wordmark

* Matching IX typography between the emblem and wordmark

* An editable business descriptor such as Luxury

* Tapered/light-ray graphic elements

* Editable tagline

* Organized Adobe Illustrator layers

* Dark, light and transparent versions

* Watermark and social/profile versions

* Files suitable for website, eBay, social media, business cards, print, packaging and product photography

* Animation-ready layered artwork for possible future motion graphics



The reference artwork contains AI-generated typography, so some text will need to be rebuilt using actual professional fonts rather than traced.



I do **not** want automated Image Trace or AI recreation used as a substitute for clean manual vector construction.



### Editable Brand System



The Illustrator master should keep the major components separate and editable, including:



* Cloud

* Emblem IX

* CLOUD IX wordmark

* Descriptor

* Light rays

* Tagline

* Color/metallic effects

* Backgrounds



The goal is to reuse the same Cloud IX base structure for different brands in the future.



### Deliverables



The complete project will ultimately require:



* Editable Adobe Illustrator `.AI` master with live text

* Outlined production `.AI` version

* SVG

* EPS

* PDF

* Transparent PNG versions

* Dark/light background versions

* Emblem/profile-image version

* Watermark version

* Font list

* Editable brand colors

* Animation-ready layered artwork



### Confidentiality & Ownership



This project is confidential.



The reference artwork, logo, drafts, source files and finished work may **not be posted publicly, displayed in a portfolio or social media, reused for another client, shared with third parties, subcontracted, or uploaded to public AI systems without my written permission.**



I require all custom source files and exclusive rights to the completed custom work.



Please confirm in your application that you agree to these requirements.



### How to Apply



**Begin your application with the words “Vector First.”**



Please keep your application concise and answer the following:



1. How many years have you used Adobe Illustrator professionally?

2. Please provide 2–4 examples of your strongest manual vector/logo work.

3. Briefly describe your process for rebuilding an existing raster logo into a clean, editable Illustrator master without relying on Image Trace.

4. Have you created editable brand/logo systems with multiple variations?

5. Are you comfortable providing organized Illustrator files with live editable text?

6. Do you have Adobe After Effects or logo-animation experience?

7. Please confirm that you will not publish, share, reuse or display this project without written permission.

8. What is your hourly rate and typical availability?



Shortlisted applicants may be offered a **small paid Illustrator skills test** before the full project.



There is potential for **ongoing design work** for the right person, including website graphics, social media assets, marketplace headers, watermarks, print materials and possibly motion graphics.



Please keep your response concise. I am more interested in your actual Illustrator work and technical approach than a long cover letter.

title: Virtual Training Coach
description:
Hi,



I'm looking for someone to become my virtual training partner AND fitness coach on an ongoing basis.



This is a little different from a normal online personal training role.



I'm looking for someone who wants to share the journey - I will be motivated by not just being told what to do but hearing about your journey too.



I would like someone that is looking to train regularly themselves, share progress with each other and for you to motivate me.



I'd like someone who is:

* Positive, fun and engaging

* Reliable with daily communication

* Comfortable sending voice notes, pictures and videos

* Comfortable receiving workout pictures/videos from me

* Happy having regular video calls

* Willing to challenge me

* Able to have some banter

* Interested in actually getting to know the person they're coaching



What the job entails:

* Initial assessment of current position

* Creation of workout plan and diet goals

* Set timings for check ins and daily communication

* Track progress by preferred method

* Tweak plans where necessary

* Create engaging content to keep motivation



I'd expect communication most days, although it can be very quick messages whenever suits. 



Some days it could simply be:



**“Gym done ? Here's today's session.”**



Other days we might have a longer conversation about training, food, motivation or progress.







You don't necessarily need to be a qualified personal trainer. You could be a:

* Personal trainer

* Fitness coach

* Sports science student/graduate

* Gym enthusiast

* Someone who simply loves training and takes their fitness seriously



Being actively involved in your own fitness journey is essential.



Pay:

Initial budget is around $100–$150 USD per month, depending on experience and how involved you would like to be.



If we work well together, I'd like this to become a long-term arrangement.



## How to apply



Please send me:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your current fitness/training goals

3. Your expected monthly rate

4. Experience of this type of work if possible

5. A recent fitness/workout photo if you're comfortable sharing one

6. A 30–60 second video introducing yourself



Please start your application with the words:



**TRAINING PARTNER**



I'm looking for someone I'll enjoy speaking to and who genuinely wants to get fitter, stronger and healthier alongside me.



Thanks,

Aaron

title: Virtual Assistant - Land Acquisition & Lead Management
description:
Virtual Assistant – Land Acquisition & Lead Management



Full-Time | 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time | $7 USD/hour + Bonuses



We are a growing U.S.-based land investment company looking for a full-time Virtual Assistant based in the Philippines to become an important part of our acquisitions team.



This is not simply a data-entry position. You will be communicating directly with landowners who are considering selling their property, building relationships with them, gathering important information, and helping move opportunities through our acquisition process.



Rapport, communication, organization, and follow-through are extremely important in this role.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and the opportunity to grow with our company.



What You’ll Be Doing



Your primary responsibility will be helping us communicate with and qualify landowners who respond to our marketing.



Responsibilities include:



* Communicating with landowners through Launch Control

* Calling new leads and responding quickly when inquiries come in

* Speaking with property owners to understand their situation, motivation, timeline, and expectations

* Building genuine rapport and trust with sellers

* Qualifying leads before they are passed to our acquisitions team for an offer

* Setting expectations with sellers regarding the next steps in our process

* Scheduling follow-up calls and tasks

* Following up consistently with leads who are not ready to sell immediately

* Accurately updating every conversation and lead status inside Stride CRM

* Maintaining detailed notes so anyone on the team can understand the history of the lead

* Keeping the CRM organized and ensuring leads do not fall through the cracks

* Helping identify motivated sellers and higher-priority opportunities

* Assisting with additional land acquisition and administrative tasks as the company grows



Who We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



* Speaks and writes excellent, fluent English

* Is confident speaking with U.S.-based property owners on the phone

* Has strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills

* Is comfortable having real conversations rather than simply reading from a script

* Is organized and detail-oriented

* Understands the importance of accurate CRM notes and follow-up

* Is reliable and takes their work seriously

* Takes initiative instead of waiting to be told what to do

* Is comfortable being held accountable for results

* Can work independently while communicating well with a team

* Wants to learn and improve

* Is interested in building a long-term career with a growing company



Real estate, land investing, acquisitions, wholesaling, cold calling, lead management, or sales experience is highly preferred but not required for the right person.



Experience with Launch Control, Stride CRM, Podio, REsimpli, GoHighLevel, or similar systems is also a plus.



Schedule



This is a full-time position working U.S. Eastern Time hours.



Monday–Friday

9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time



You must be comfortable consistently working this schedule from the Philippines.



Compensation



Starting pay: $6 USD per hour



There will be opportunities for:



* Performance-based bonuses

* Pay increases based on performance and responsibility

* Increased responsibilities

* Leadership opportunities

The Type of Person Who Will Succeed Here



We are looking for someone who approaches the business with an ownership mentality.

What matters most is that you are dependable, coachable, hardworking, personable, and serious about growing with the company.



For the right person, this can develop into a much larger role as our land investment business grows.



How to Apply
