title: Controller
description:
Ikigai Cases is hiring a Controller!

Location: Remote / Work From Home

Reports to: CEO





About the Company

Ikigai Cases (
) is a fast-growing ecommerce brand manufacturing aerospace-grade aluminum pill cases. Founded in December 2021 by two brothers after their father’s neurological diagnosis led them to discovering the issues with plastic pill organizers, we’ve built a multi-million dollar business in just over four years with a team of 25 across the globe. 



Our mission is simple: make exceptional pill cases and provide exceptional customer service. We deliver on this by managing in-house fulfillment at our Washington, DC facility (including custom engraving) and maintaining obsessive attention to detail.





About the Role

We are hiring a Controller to take complete ownership of our financial operations - accounting, reporting, payroll, budgeting, cash flow, tax coordination, and financial systems. This is a critical senior role, and we’re looking for someone whose professional identity is built around three things: the integrity of the numbers, running the finance function end-to-end, and providing strategic financial insight to the CEO.



The ideal candidate has served as a Controller (or equivalent) for an e-commerce or DTC brand in the $10–30M revenue range. You understand the financial rhythms of e-commerce: Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow swings, sales tax across multiple states, and the speed at which decisions need to be made. If you’ve done this before at a similar-sized company, you already know what we need.



We need someone who builds systems, not just operates inside them. You’ll report directly to the CEO and work hand-in-hand with our external financial advisor. No layers of management between you and the decisions your work supports.









Core Responsibilities

Monthly Close & Financial Reporting: Close books by the 10th of every month. Produce reviewed P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements in Finaloop. Resolve misclassifications proactively. Maintain a clean chart of accounts. No CEO intervention required.



Budgeting & Financial Planning: Prepare and maintain monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets. Own budget vs. actuals: produce variance reports monthly alongside the P&L close with plain-language explanations. Update balance sheet items and expenses weekly inside the company’s financial models.



Cash Flow Management & Forecasting: Maintain the 13-week cash flow forecast weekly and proactively. Flag upcoming cash movements, exposure, and risks before they become surprises. This is one of the most critical tools the CEO uses for capital allocation.



Payroll Operations (Zero-Error Standard): Own bi-weekly payroll across ADP (US) and Deel (Philippines). Submit the morning of payroll day, every cycle. PTO, overtime, and deductions captured before submission. You catch discrepancies before they reach the CEO.



Tax Coordination & Compliance: Own the relationship with Numeral on multi-state sales tax filings. Maintain the estimated tax payment tracker. Coordinate with our external CPA on annual filings. Flag tax exposure and timing proactively.

Vendor Payments, Disbursements & Financial Systems: Execute and double-check all vendor payments (Venmo, PayPal, wire). Track owner distributions and related-party transactions. Manage Finaloop, Shopify revenue reconciliation, and Google Sheets financial modeling. Manage financial admin including insurance, vendor accounts, and benefits.



CEO Reporting & Ad Hoc Analysis: Weekly: 13WCF update, flagged variances, upcoming cash movements. Monthly: clean financial statements with brief narrative. As needed: ad hoc financial analysis without requiring a detailed spec.



Why You Should Take This Role

-You’ll work at a brand obsessed with its customers, with a loyal following. Read the reviews: 

-A company that’s scaled rapidly in 4 years and is aggressively investing in growth.

-You’ll work hand-in-hand with the founder, not through layers of management, with full autonomy to own your domain.

-The company was founded to solve a personal problem - Tavish’s father battled a neurological condition for a decade and the family discovered the issues with plastic pill organizers.

-You’ll own the entire financial function for a company on a trajectory from $11.5M to $30M - a career-defining role for the right person.





Required Experience & Skills

-5+ years in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance operations

-Prior Controller or senior finance role at a company doing $10M+ in annual revenue - you’ve owned the full financial function, not just pieces of it

-E-commerce or DTC company experience strongly preferred - Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow, multi-state sales tax

-Experience closing books independently, on a monthly cadence, without supervision

-Demonstrated accuracy record - you should be able to speak to this specifically

-US GAAP familiarity (CPA not required, but you must understand the principles)

-Experience preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets

-Payroll experience across multiple platforms

-Advanced Google Sheets / Excel (SUMIFS, financial modeling, pivot tables)

-Strong proficiency with Finaloop, QuickBooks Online, or equivalent cloud accounting platform

-Strong written and verbal English; ability to explain financial insights to non-financial stakeholders





Nice-to-Have Experience

-Experience working remotely for a US-based company from the Philippines

-Exposure to sales tax compliance across multiple US states

-Experience using Notion (or similar task management software)

-EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) familiarity

-Prior experience coordinating with external CPAs and tax advisors





What We’re Really Looking For

-Technical skills get you in the door. These traits determine whether you succeed:

-Detail orientation as professional pride - you catch your own errors before they go out, and you change your process so they don’t recur.

-Proactive disclosure - you surface problems before being asked, even when it’s uncomfortable.

-Ownership without supervision - if it’s due, it’s done. No prompting required.

-Direct communication - you push back when something doesn’t look right.

-Reliability - when you say you’ll be available, you’re available. When you can’t be, you say so immediately.





Compensation Details & Schedule

-Compensation: TBD based on candidate experience. Target compensation will be requested during screening.

-Work Hours: 50 hours/week, Monday–Friday. Core overlap with US Eastern hours (9AM–5PM EST).

-Paid Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

title: Google Ads Search Specialist - Local Lead Generation
description:
30-Day Paid Trial | Brisbane Australia 



TintGard is looking for a Google Ads Search specialist with proven experience generating high-intent leads for local service businesses.



This is a focused 30-day paid trial.



One market. Four weeks to demonstrate what you can do.



Perform well and there is an opportunity for ongoing management with revised compensation as we scale.



THE OBJECTIVE



Generate qualified window-tinting enquiries across Brisbane at a commercially viable cost.



Window tinting. No automotive.



Heat reduction is the biggest customer problem we solve.



Your job is to determine how customers are actually searching for our services and capture the highest-intent, commercially valuable searches.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITY



You will take ownership of the Google Search campaign, including:



* Keyword and search-intent research

* Campaign/ad-group structure

* Match types

* Negative keywords

* Brisbane-wide targeting

* Ad copy

* Assets/extensions

* Bidding

* Budget allocation

* Conversion tracking

* Search-term analysis

* Wasted-spend reduction

* Testing

* Ongoing optimisation



We want people genuinely looking for professional window tinting.



We don’t want traffic for the sake of traffic.



LANDING PAGE & CONVERSION



You are responsible for creating and launching the conversion-focused landing page required for the campaign.



This does not need to be a complex website development project.



It needs to be a simple, fast, mobile-friendly landing page designed to convert high-intent Google Search traffic into calls and enquiries.



You are responsible for:



* Landing-page structure

* Headline and messaging

* Copy

* CTA

* Form

* Click-to-call

* Trust/social proof

* Mobile experience

* Conversion tracking

* Basic CRO and optimisation during the trial



TintGard will provide the required branding, genuine project photos, reviews and business information.



The landing page must be ready for the campaign to launch.



SEARCH - AD - LANDING PAGE - ENQUIRY



You own the paid customer journey from the search through to the enquiry.



30 DAYS OF ACTIVE MANAGEMENT



This is not a setup-and-disappear job.



The campaign needs active attention throughout the trial.



BUILD - LAUNCH - WATCH - LEARN - ADJUST - REPEAT



You will:



* Monitor actual search terms

* Add negative keywords quickly

* Identify wasted spend

* Remove irrelevant traffic

* Monitor lead quality

* Test ads

* Adjust keywords and match types

* Optimise bids and budget

* Verify conversion tracking

* Improve landing-page conversion

* Move spend toward what produces genuine opportunities



DAILY COLLABORATION



There are only four weeks, so we will collaborate every business day as required.



I don’t want to wait until the end of the week to discover money has been wasted or an opportunity has been missed.



This does not mean long daily meetings or reports.



It means you are actively checking the campaign and we communicate quickly when something needs attention.



I will provide direct feedback on:



LEAD QUALITY - QUOTES - JOBS



so you can optimise against actual business outcomes rather than Google Ads numbers alone.



THE SCOREBOARD



Clicks, impressions and CTR are useful diagnostic information.



They are not success.



AD SPEND - QUALIFIED LEADS - QUOTES - JOBS - REVENUE



We will monitor:



* Ad spend

* Leads

* Qualified leads

* Cost per lead

* Cost per qualified lead

* Quotes

* Jobs won

* Customer acquisition cost

* Revenue generated



A qualified lead means a genuine prospective Brisbane customer seeking professional window tinting.



OWNERSHIP



TintGard owns and controls:



* Google Ads account

* Billing

* Campaigns

* Landing page

* Conversion tracking

* Campaign data

* Campaign assets



Advertising spend is paid directly by TintGard to Google.



30-DAY PAID TRIAL



Fixed payment: $250 AUD



This is the trial rate, not the proposed long-term management rate.



The purpose of the first 30 days is to demonstrate your capability and establish whether we work well together.



Produce commercially viable results and there is an opportunity for:



ONGOING MANAGEMENT + REVISED COMPENSATION + INCREASED AD SPEND



If you can make the advertising profitable, we want to scale it.



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR



You should already know how to manage:



* Google Search Ads

* High-intent local lead generation

* Search intent

* Keyword research

* Match types

* Negative keywords

* Search-term optimisation

title: People & Talent Lead
description:
Please Apply on our website: 



OVERVIEW

At Clipmasters, people are the product.



We’re a fast-growing, remote-first creative production company working with editors, designers, motion creatives, marketers, and operational tea
mbers across multiple countries and cultures. As we scale, we’re looking for a People & Talent Lead who will take ownership of how we hire, onboard, support, and grow our team.



This is a foundational role. You’ll be our first dedicated people hire and will work closely with the founders and our in-house trainer to shape the people side of Clipmasters with intention, clarity, and care — while keeping a high bar for quality and professionalism.



WHAT THIS ROLE LOOKS LIKE IN PRACTISE



You’ll step into a company where a lot is already in motion. We’ve built hiring pipelines and systems that work — your job is to run them well, improve them where needed, and build the internal people structure that supports long-term growth.



You’ll be close to the team. Through regular 1:1s and check-ins, you’ll notice patterns, spot issues early, and help people grow in a way that’s good for them and for the company. You’ll also be comfortable speaking up when something isn’t working and proposing better ways forward.



REQUIREMENTS:

- You have solid experience in people operations, talent acquisition, HR, or a similar role

- You’ve worked in creative, agency, or digital environments

- You’re emotionally intelligent and comfortable having honest conversations

- You enjoy building structure and improving systems

- You like combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution

- You’re excited to grow into a Head of People or People & Culture Lead over time



RESPONSIBILITIES:

A large part of your role will be owning hiring from start to finish, including:

- Reviewing applications and trial tasks

- Running interviews across time zones

- Guiding candidates through our Test Week (together with our trainer)

- Making clear, thoughtful hiring recommendations

- Handling offers, contracts, and expectation-setting



Beyond hiring, you’ll help build the internal people foundation of Clipmasters, such as:

- A clear, human onboarding experience

- Internal guidelines and feedback cycles

- Performance and development conversations

- People documentation suited for a global, remote team

 

You’ll also contribute to how it feels to work at Clipmasters by:

- Holding quarterly 1:1s and development check-ins

- Supporting individual growth paths with the trainer

- Strengthening team connection and culture across time zones

- Helping celebrate wins, milestones, and progress

 

As we grow, this role will naturally expand into shaping our long-term people strategy and building a small people team.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Full-time, fully remote role

- Competitive compensation based on experience and location

- High ownership and autonomy after onboarding

- Close collaboration with founders and leadership

- A clear path into senior people leadership

- A creative, mission-driven environment where people matter

 

If this role sounds like something you’d genuinely enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.



Please apply on our website:

title: Outbound Sales Development Representative/Appointment Setter (Freelance)
description:
Clipmasters runs a video editing and design subscription for agencies and content businesses. We're looking for a sharp, self-driven outbound sales development representative to own our appointment-setting process from day one. Ideally, this is someone who can, relatively quickly, take on running sales calls and closing deals as well, and who has the capability to eventually own our whole sales process and help manage the sales team as we build it out.



If the first two months go well, this can turn into a long-term role with real room to grow into sales leadership.



The Role



You'll start by owning the entire outbound process, end to end: building targeted lists, running cold outreach, and booking qualified calls for our CEO/founder. You won't be starting from scratch: we hand you a proven playbook with sequences, scripts, and objection handling built from the outreach that signed our current clients.



If you prove yourself, there's an opportunity to move into running the sales calls yourself and closing deals, and for the right person, into owning our sales process and helping manage the sales team longer term.



What You'll Do



- Build and maintain targeted lists of video production companies, videographers, and creative agencies in our target markets, using ICP and targeting criteria we provide.

- Run cold
 sequences, LinkedIn outreach, IG DM campaigns, and cold calls, bringing your own tools and ideas on how to structure the process.

- Turn positive replies into booked calls with our CEO/founder. A call only counts as qualified if the prospect is a decision maker, has already seen our work, and already knows our pricing going in.

- Handle confirmations, reminders, and rebooking no-shows, since a booked call that doesn't happen doesn't count.

- Down the line: run sales calls, close deals, and potentially help manage the sales team as we build it out.



What We're Looking For



- You do the work yourself. No agencies, no teams, no delegating to juniors.

- Excellent written and spoken English. You'll be writing to prospects in our name, and agency owners notice templated writing immediately.

- A track record of booking B2B meetings, ideally for agencies or service businesses, with real numbers to back it up.

- Bonus: experience running sales calls, closing deals, or leading a small sales team.

- Flexibility to work across time zones for calls and same-day reply handling, including Australia.

- Comfortable reporting weekly on contacts, replies, bookings, and show rate.

- Genuine ambition to grow into a sales leadership role.



What We Offer



- A proven playbook, scripts, case studies, and a full asset library for follow-ups

- Pricing you're allowed to share openly with prospects

- Freedom to run your own stack and methods

- Fast, direct feedback from the CEO/founder

- Hourly rate plus a bonus for every qualified call booked

- A long-term role if the first two months go well, with real room to grow into sales leadership



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions to be considered for this position:



- Tell us about one outbound campaign you personally ran end to end: how you built the list, which channels you used, the volume, the reply rate, and how many meetings it booked. Start your answer with the word "overnight" so we know you read this.

- Tell us about any experience you have running sales calls, closing deals, or leading a small sales team. If you don't have this yet, say so honestly and tell us why you're confident you could grow into it.

- Write a three-sentence cold
 you'd send to the owner of a busy video production company, introducing our service (check out 
 first). No AI-generated filler; we can tell.

- Confirm that you personally, not a team, will be doing this work, plus your time zone and realistic weekly availability.

- Which tools would you use for list building, sending, and tracking, and how would you structure your first 30 days with us?



Applications that skip these are declined without reading.

DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT DIRECT SHORT-TERM RENTAL / AIRBNB EXPERIENCE.



Applications without STR experience will not be reviewed.



ABOUT US



Higgihaus runs a portfolio of aparthotels across Bristol and Cardiff in the UK. We have spent seven years building an operation that runs on tight systems, good data, and a small team that trusts each other. We are not a giant call centre and we never will be. We are a lean operations team that takes guest experience and operational quality seriously.



You would be joining our remote operations team, working alongside our existing operations VA on the evening shift, with a daily overlap hour for handover and team connection. You will be trained directly by the founder and supported as you find your feet. This is a genuine team, not a set of people who only ever clock on when someone else clocks off.



THE ROLE



This is a front-line guest operations role at its core. Your main job is to deliver brilliant, responsive guest communications and keep the operation running smoothly across your morning shift. Much of our routine guest messaging is already handled by automation, so this is not a high-volume copy-paste job. It is about handling the situations that need a real person: judgement calls, live problems during a guest's stay, escalations, the occasional phone call, and keeping guests happy when things do not go to plan.



You need to be a genuinely good communicator. Warm, clear, calm under pressure. That part is non-negotiable because it is the heart of the job.



Your morning shift is our quieter one. You will often be the only person online for the start of the shift. That means real responsibility from early on, and it means we need someone who can make a sensible call and explain their reasoning afterwards, rather than someone waiting to be told what to do.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Own guest communications across your shift: enquiries, in-stay issues, escalations from our AI comms system

- Handle live operational problems: lockouts, cleaning issues, maintenance coordination with our UK team

- Take the occasional guest phone call in clear, confident English

- Monitor and action the daily operations picture: arrivals, departures, flags from our automated reports

- Keep our systems accurate: Hostaway, Airtable records, task tracking

- Spot recurring problems and raise them with the fix, not just the complaint



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Direct short-term rental / Airbnb industry experience

- Impeccable written English and confident spoken English on the phone

- Comfortable and reliable on the fixed Friday to Tuesday, 8am to 4pm UK shift, every week, including Sunday

- Strong tech proficiency: quick to learn new software, comfortable with AI tools

- Experience with a PMS (Hostaway ideal), Airtable or Asana, and ideally PriceLabs or Wheelhouse

- A root-cause mindset: you dig into why a problem keeps happening

- Reliable home setup: fast internet and a backup plan for power or connection outages

- Full-time and exclusive: no other employers alongside this role



WHAT YOU GET



- A stable, long-term full-time role with a team that has operated for seven years

- Trained directly by the founder, with real investment in your development

- A fixed shift, so your body clock and your life outside work stay predictable

- Genuine growth path into revenue management, team lead, and AI automation upskilling for the right person

- A team culture built on trust and directness, not micromanagement



Available Friday to Tuesday, 8:00am to 4:00pm UK time, every week. This is a fixed shift, not flexible hours.



This role is exclusive. You cannot hold another client or role alongside it and is a contractual requirement. 



What matters more than your tool list:



Judgement. You can tell the difference between a guest with a real problem and a guest trying it on, and you handle both without losing your temper or giving away money that is not yours.



Ownership. When something goes wrong at 8:15 and nobody is reachable, you act, then tell us what you did.

Curiosity about why. When something breaks, you want to know the cause, not just the workaround.



How to apply



Two steps. Applications missing either one will not be reviewed.



1. Complete the application form: 



2. Record and upload a one-minute video. The upload link is at the end of the form.



This does not need to be polished. Phone camera, no editing, no script read aloud. We want to hear how you actually speak.



In the video, answer this:



A guest is four nights into a six-night stay. They message you saying the property is filthy and they want a full refund. Tell me what you would do, and what you would say to them.



Speak to camera. One minute. First take is fine.



We do not review applications without a video. This is not a formality. Spoken communication is the core of this job, and we would rather assess it at the start than waste your time and ours.



YOU WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED IF YOU DO NOT SUBMIT A VIDEO. 



DEADLINE: Monday 17th August 2026 for All applications 



Please apply directly. We are not working with agencies for this role.

title: HVAC Quality Engineer
description:
The HVAC Quality Engineer is a critical technical role responsible for developing, implementing, and enforcing quality assurance and control processes for all heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems, installations, and service protocols.



This position requires a strong engineering background and an in-depth technical understanding of HVAC systems and components to ensure all work meets stringent quality, performance, and safety standards, as well as relevant industry and regulatory codes (e.g., ASHRAE, local building codes). The shift is structured to support evening operations and review daily project outputs from field teams.



Position Summary

The Quality Engineer will move beyond procurement and scheduling to focus entirely on technical compliance, validation, and continuous improvement. Key responsibilities include analyzing non-conformance issues, performing root cause analysis (RCA), managing corrective and preventative actions (CAPA), and auditing installation and repair work for adherence to specifications and quality manuals.



Job Responsibilities

Quality Assurance & Control: Develop, document, and maintain Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) standards for all HVAC service, repair, and installation activities.

Auditing & Inspection: Conduct technical reviews and audits of completed work orders, parts specifications, and installation documentation to ensure absolute compliance with engineering drawings, manufacturer instructions, and industry codes.

Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Investigate quality failures, recurring issues, and customer complaints related to system performance or installation errors to determine the fundamental root cause.

Corrective & Preventative Action (CAPA): Develop and manage a system for corrective actions to resolve quality issues and implement preventative measures to stop recurrence.

Technical Documentation: Maintain detailed quality records, generate non-conformance reports (NCRs), and ensure all quality manuals and engineering specifications are current and accessible.

Technical Support: Provide expert technical guidance and feedback to field technicians and operations management regarding complex procedures, adherence to quality checkpoints, and code compliance.

Job Requirements & Desired Qualifications



Education and Experience

Required: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering.

Minimum of 3+ years of experience in Quality Assurance/Control, Field Engineering, or a similar technical role within the HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or construction trades.

Demonstrated technical understanding of HVAC system design, operational principles, components (e.g., control systems, heat transfer, refrigeration circuits), and relevant diagnostic tools.



Skills and Competencies

Strong Analytical Skills: Proficient in using data-driven methods (e.g., 5 Whys, Ishikawa Diagram) for failure analysis and problem-solving.

Detail-Oriented: Exceptional attention to detail in documentation, auditing, and enforcing technical specifications.

Communication: Clear, confident, and professional technical communicator, capable of conveying complex non-compliance issues and corrective steps to technical staff and management.

Code Knowledge: Familiarity with major industry standards and codes (e.g., ASHRAE, ACCA, and local building codes).

Software Proficiency: Experience using quality management software, technical analysis tools, and Microsoft Office Suite.



Success Factors

Problem Solver: A quick thinker who can efficiently analyze technical failures and develop practical, long-term solutions.

Reliable and Consistent: Able to maintain strict adherence to quality procedures during the evening shift hours.

Process-Driven: Passionate about refining and improving technical processes to ensure superior workmanship and customer satisfaction.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Ikigai Cases is hiring a Controller!

Location: Remote / Work From Home

Reports to: CEO





About the Company

Ikigai Cases (
) is a fast-growing ecommerce brand manufacturing aerospace-grade aluminum pill cases. Founded in December 2021 by two brothers after their father’s neurological diagnosis led them to discovering the issues with plastic pill organizers, we’ve built a multi-million dollar business in just over four years with a team of 25 across the globe.



Our mission is simple: make exceptional pill cases and provide exceptional customer service. We deliver on this by managing in-house fulfillment at our Washington, DC facility (including custom engraving) and maintaining obsessive attention to detail.





About the Role

We are hiring a Controller to take complete ownership of our financial operations - accounting, reporting, payroll, budgeting, cash flow, tax coordination, and financial systems. This is a critical senior role, and we’re looking for someone whose professional identity is built around three things: the integrity of the numbers, running the finance function end-to-end, and providing strategic financial insight to the CEO.



The ideal candidate has served as a Controller (or equivalent) for an e-commerce or DTC brand in the $10–30M revenue range. You understand the financial rhythms of e-commerce: Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow swings, sales tax across multiple states, and the speed at which decisions need to be made. If you’ve done this before at a similar-sized company, you already know what we need.



We need someone who builds systems, not just operates inside them. You’ll report directly to the CEO and work hand-in-hand with our external financial advisor. No layers of management between you and the decisions your work supports.





Core Responsibilities

Monthly Close & Financial Reporting: Close books by the 10th of every month. Produce reviewed P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements in Finaloop. Resolve misclassifications proactively. Maintain a clean chart of accounts. No CEO intervention required.



Budgeting & Financial Planning: Prepare and maintain monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets. Own budget vs. actuals: produce variance reports monthly alongside the P&L close with plain-language explanations. Update balance sheet items and expenses weekly inside the company’s financial models.



Cash Flow Management & Forecasting: Maintain the 13-week cash flow forecast weekly and proactively. Flag upcoming cash movements, exposure, and risks before they become surprises. This is one of the most critical tools the CEO uses for capital allocation.



Payroll Operations (Zero-Error Standard): Own bi-weekly payroll across ADP (US) and Deel (Philippines). Submit the morning of payroll day, every cycle. PTO, overtime, and deductions captured before submission. You catch discrepancies before they reach the CEO.



Tax Coordination & Compliance: Own the relationship with Numeral on multi-state sales tax filings. Maintain the estimated tax payment tracker. Coordinate with our external CPA on annual filings. Flag tax exposure and timing proactively.

Vendor Payments, Disbursements & Financial Systems: Execute and double-check all vendor payments (Venmo, PayPal, wire). Track owner distributions and related-party transactions. Manage Finaloop, Shopify revenue reconciliation, and Google Sheets financial modeling. Manage financial admin including insurance, vendor accounts, and benefits.



CEO Reporting & Ad Hoc Analysis: Weekly: 13WCF update, flagged variances, upcoming cash movements. Monthly: clean financial statements with brief narrative. As needed: ad hoc financial analysis without requiring a detailed spec.



Why You Should Take This Role

-You’ll work at a brand obsessed with its customers, with a loyal following. Read the reviews: 
/pages/reviews

-A company that’s scaled rapidly in 4 years and is aggressively investing in growth.

-You’ll work hand-in-hand with the founder, not through layers of management, with full autonomy to own your domain.

-The company was founded to solve a personal problem - Tavish’s father battled a neurological condition for a decade and the family discovered the issues with plastic pill organizers.

-You’ll own the entire financial function for a company on a trajectory from $11.5M to $30M - a career-defining role for the right person.





Required Experience & Skills

-5+ years in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance operations

-Prior Controller or senior finance role at a company doing $10M+ in annual revenue - you’ve owned the full financial function, not just pieces of it

-E-commerce or DTC company experience strongly preferred - Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow, multi-state sales tax

-Experience closing books independently, on a monthly cadence, without supervision

-Demonstrated accuracy record - you should be able to speak to this specifically

-US GAAP familiarity (CPA not required, but you must understand the principles)

-Experience preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets

-Payroll experience across multiple platforms

-Advanced Google Sheets / Excel (SUMIFS, financial modeling, pivot tables)

-Strong proficiency with Finaloop, QuickBooks Online, or equivalent cloud accounting platform

-Strong written and verbal English; ability to explain financial insights to non-financial stakeholders





Nice-to-Have Experience

-Experience working remotely for a US-based company from the Philippines

-Exposure to sales tax compliance across multiple US states

-Experience using Notion (or similar task management software)

-EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) familiarity

-Prior experience coordinating with external CPAs and tax advisors





What We’re Really Looking For

-Technical skills get you in the door. These traits determine whether you succeed:

-Detail orientation as professional pride - you catch your own errors before they go out, and you change your process so they don’t recur.

-Proactive disclosure - you surface problems before being asked, even when it’s uncomfortable.

-Ownership without supervision - if it’s due, it’s done. No prompting required.

-Direct communication - you push back when something doesn’t look right.

-Reliability - when you say you’ll be available, you’re available. When you can’t be, you say so immediately.

title: Client Activation Manager (Customer Success and Tech Support) - $900 p/m + Bonuses (Up to $1,400/month)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Facebook Ads D2C Video Editor
description:
We're looking for a video editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products in the health and wellness niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for an editor who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, UG-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



— WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING —



You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- AI voiceover ads: A simple combination of voiceover and b-rolls, chosen carefully and enhanced with copy, graphic and sound effects, zooms, transitions, etc.

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around

education and direct-response structure

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



— WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR —



We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals.

We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to edit videos that:

- Stop people in the first 1-3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes... then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing.



— THE KIND OF EDITOR WHO WILL THRIVE HERE —



You'll be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



— SKILLS & EXPERIENCE —



Ideally, you have experience with:

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- ??Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with in the health and wellness niche.



— WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY —



- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



— WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU —



- Competitive compensation based on experience

- Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively



How to Apply:

To apply, simply fill out this Google Form:

We will review all submissions and contact the shortlisted candidates via
.



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for an editor who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.



If you're an e-commerce ad video editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Static Ad Designer for DTC creative - Phase
description:
Static Ad Designer for Phase (Part-time / Freelance)



We're looking for a Static Ad Designer who lives and breathes DTC creative and can compete with the brands you already follow on Meta. Starting part-time / freelance, with clear room to scale hours as our creative volume grows.



Who we are



Phase is a fast-growing DTC brand redefining the digital welness category. We ship a physical app-blocker device that thousands of people use daily to reclaim their attention and get better focus.



- Featured across major DTC newsletters and press

- 4.9? across 2,000+ units sold in 19 countries

- Scaling our Meta creative engine hard, statics are our leading edge



The role



Not a graphic designer who occasionally does ads. Someone who knows exactly why brands like Eight Sleep's their device shots outperform 90% of competitors and can produce the same craft bar for Phase.



You'll own the visual side of our static pipeline: starting at ~8-10 statics per week (both 4:5 and 9:16), scaling up as we ramp. Working from strategic briefs and reference ads. Print-grade execution, no shortcuts, no cheap tells.



What you'll actually do



- Turn briefed concepts into finished statics in Figma ? export-ready

- Art-direct every ad: composition, hierarchy, whitespace, type, tension

- Work with our growing competitor/reference library (Atria), pull the right layout DNA per concept

- Iterate fast on winners, kill non-performers, feed craft learnings back into the system

- Collaborate on image-generation prompts (Higgsfield, Nano Banana Pro) when a swipe or new concept calls for it

- Own the craft bar, nothing ships that couldn't sit next to Oura or Eight Sleep in the feed



Who you are



Non-negotiables:



- Deep Figma expert. Auto-layout, variants, components, tokens, brand systems, not just "I've used it"

- Proven DTC static ad portfolio. Meta and/or TikTok, real ad accounts, real spend behind the work

- Worked at premium-brand tier. Statics for at least one high-craft DTC brand (agency, in-house, or freelance)

- Currently active in the market. You know what's converting right now, which concepts are trending, which brands set the bar this quarter

- Native art-direction sense. You see immediately why one static works and another doesn't, and can articulate it



Bonus signals:



- Mention the brands you made statics for with examples to get bonus points

- Familiar with the brands we benchmark against: Hears, Oura, Eight Sleep, reMarkable, WHOOP, Brick

- Comfort with reference-driven creative (swipe-and-elevate, not blank-slate)

- Experience with image generation tools (Higgsfield, Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney)

- Own opinions on why certain concepts convert (UvT vs Editorial vs Spec-sheet, etc.)



How we work



- Small focused team, direct communication, no politics

- Weekly performance data, you see what your work is doing in the ad account

- Autonomy over craft with a very high bar

- Feedback loop measured in days, not weeks

- Remote-first (HQ in Dubai, team distributed globally)



Structure



- Type: Freelance / part-time to start

- Hours: ~10-15 hours per week to begin (roughly 8-10 statics/week)

- Rate: €35-45/hr depending on portfolio + speed (or per-static rate if that fits your workflow better, let's discuss)

- Trajectory: Room to scale hours + rate as volume grows and we prove the match. Could evolve into a permanent seat.

- Location: Remote. Timezone overlap with GST helpful but not required.



How to apply



Send us:



1. 3-5 static ads YOU designed for DTC brands. Links or attachments. For each: brand name, platform (Meta/TikTok), and one line on what made it convert.



2. The brands you've worked on for static ads. Be specific: brand name, your role (agency / in-house / freelance), what you shipped (roughly how many statics), and over what period. Applications without this list won't be reviewed.



3. A 3-sentence take on the current DTC static market. Which concept type do you see winning right now, and why?



4. Your Figma workflow. How you set up files, use components, keep things systematic across many variants.



5. Rate/salary expectation + availability (hours/week you can commit).



Send to: 



We read every application. If your portfolio hits the bar you'll hear back within 5 working days with a paid test brief.



Why apply



You'll design for a brand that treats creative as the growth lever, not an afterthought. Real budgets, real data, real feedback. Your work goes live within days. You'll see it convert (or not) with your name on it. If you're the person we're looking for, this is the seat where your craft compounds fastest.

title: n8n Automation Developer — Automated Video Rendering Pipeline (FFmpeg)
description:
We produce long-form videos at volume. Right now the assembly is manual and it's the bottleneck.



We want an n8n workflow that renders finished videos end-to-end, unattended. You give it a topic or a row in a sheet, it comes back with a finished MP4.



The pipeline needs to:



1. Take a job in — from a Google Sheet row



2. Source footage — from two places:

- a local stock footage library (Drive folder)

- free stock APIs as fallback when the local library has no match (Pexels and Pixabay, both free for commercial use)



3. Select and sequence clips to match the script or keyword list, trim them to the right durations.



4. Composite an overlay clip on top — this is the important part. We have a branded overlay video that plays over the whole render. It has regions that are green screen/transparent, and the stock footage shows through those windows. The overlay changes at points during the video, so the pipeline has to handle multiple overlay segments in one render, not just one static layer.



5. Encode and output the final MP4 to Google Drive



6. Log and recover — every run logged, failures retried, no silent failures, no half-rendered files left behind.



Reference example of the output we want: 



Must have

- Self-hosted n8n — you've installed it yourself on a VPS or Docker, not just used the cloud UI

- FFmpeg from the command line — real fluency, specifically overlay, chromakey/colorkey, scale, concat, filter_complex. If you have only ever used a drag-and-drop editor, this role is not for you

- Execute Command / Code nodes in n8n — comfortable shelling out and handling stdout, exit codes, and file paths

- REST API integration — auth headers, pagination, rate limits, retries, caching

- Linux + SSH, file system handling, cron/queue basics

- Written English good enough to document what you built so someone else can maintain it



Nice to have

Chroma keying experience — knowing why despill and edge feathering matter

Alpha-channel video formats (ProRes 4444, VP9/WebM with alpha)

Hardware-accelerated encoding (NVENC / VAAPI / QSV)

Queue systems for long-running jobs (Redis, BullMQ, or n8n queue mode)

Prior work building unattended render pipelines at volume



Deliverables

Working n8n workflow, exported as JSON

All FFmpeg commands and helper scripts, commented

Setup documentation — how to install it fresh on a new machine

A short Loom walkthrough of how it works and how to change it

Handover

title: Australian Tax Accountant
description:
About us:

We’re an Australian accounting firm looking a Philippine based team member to assist with tasks such as producing tax returns and financial accounts from client information supplied from our office. Our team consists of a range of friendly people from Australia and the Philippines, and we value our team members above all else.



Our clients are mainly small businesses here in Australia, and we perform all types of accounting and tax services. Our clients are in a large range of industries, and you will get to experience a variety of different work.



About the role:

The role is a full-time, work from home role.



We are looking for what we consider a skilled intermediate or senior accountant - someone who has sufficient experience working with Australian accounting firms and who will be able to meet productivity targets from day 1. This role is not for those with little to no experience with Australian firms.



Non-Negotiables:

1) 3+ years experience working with Australian accounting firms

2) Highly competent with producing accurate financial statements, tax returns, BAS's, etc

3) Expectations of meeting KPI / productivity targets (essentially 80% of time billed to clients)



Please do not apply if you don't meet the above. While you may make a great candidate for a general accounting and tax role, we really need someone with the above experience at this time and who can make an immediate impact.



What we can offer:

Salary range dependent on skills and abilities, from 100,000 Peso per month to 120,000 for someone with great credentials and experience

Work from home

20 days of paid holidays (annual leave) per year

All Australian public holidays provided

Training and career growth

Work from home set-up provided (computer, screens, headset, etc)



Working Hours:

Preferred 9am to 5pm AEST (Melbourne, Australia), can be flexible



Start Date:

ASAP



Detailed Summary:

The job will involve the application of Australian taxation rules to support the preparation of Australian tax returns, BAS returns, payroll lodgments, financial statements, etc for businesses, and individuals. You are expected to be able to prepare financial statements and tax returns from various types of source documents, for review by our team leader.



Experience preparing Australian tax returns is necessary for this role. We use Xero for financial statements and tax returns, experience with Xero and Xero Tax is preferred.



A large number of our business clients use Xero and QuickBooks Online, with others using excel spreadsheets or simply forwarding across bank statements and invoices. You will be expected to work through this information, work out the most appropriate allocation in the financial statements, and work out the tax outcomes of all items.



Our team will be there to support you and assist with any and all queries you have with any of your jobs, and if there are any knowledge gaps, we are happy to train you in those areas.



We are looking for a friendly person who enjoys keeping in touch with our other team members and is willing to ask for help when needed. Our team is always available to help you, and we hold regular team meetings and have online chat to help everyone work closely together.



If this sounds like your next ideal role, then please apply now.



Application Process:

An overview of our application process is as follows

1) We will select a shortlist of candidates based on resumes for interviewing

2) Candidates that interview well will be asked to complete a test of their accounting and tax knowledge

3) If there is a stand-out candidate following the testing, we will offer that candidate a job

4) If there are multiple candidates at this point, we will conduct second interviews before making an offer

title: Outreach VA: Research & Build Relationships for Housing Provider
description:
About us

SoCal Community Homes is a supportive housing provider in Riverside County, California. We operate furnished shared homes for veterans, seniors, adults on SSI or SSDI, and people reentering the community after incarceration. We are small, we are growing, and we treat the people who work with us as part of the team.



About the role

We are building a network of referral partners: case managers, social workers, housing navigators, and program supervisors at county agencies, veteran organizations, shelters, reentry programs, and nonprofits across Riverside County. These are the professionals who place clients into housing. When they know us, they call us.



You will do both halves of this work. First you find these people. Then you reach out, introduce us, and build enough trust that they agree to a 30 minute meeting.



This is not sales. There is no product, no price, no close. Their hardest problem is finding a safe, available bed for a client who is ready to move. We have beds. That is the whole conversation, and most of them will be glad you called.



Research:

Build a verified contact list of 200 referral partners across Riverside County. For each one: full name, job title, organization, direct
, direct phone, city, and organization type. Named individuals only. General info inboxes and switchboard numbers do not count. Spread contacts across organizations rather than concentrating on any single agency. A list of cities will be provided



Outreach:

Send personalized introduction
s using our templates. Make friendly follow up calls to confirm you have the right person and invite them to a meeting. Book confirmed meetings on our calendar and send reminders. Log every call,
, and outcome in a shared tracker. Follow up on a set schedule so nothing goes cold. Keep relationships warm with periodic check ins on bed availability. Continue adding new contacts to the list as you discover them.



What success looks like

In your first XX days: a clean verified contact list, consistent weekly outreach across it, a steady flow of booked meetings, and a handful of agencies who recognize our name and reply when you write. We will set weekly targets together after training.



What we need

Excellent spoken English with a clear, warm, unscripted phone presence. You will speak with government employees and licensed social workers, so patience and clarity matter far more than speed.



Error free written English that does not read like a mass template.

Strong online research skills. You should be comfortable digging through organization websites, staff directories, LinkedIn, and public county listings to find a named person and a direct line rather than settling for a general contact form.



At least one year in appointment setting, B2B outreach, lead research, client relations, intake, or similar work. Experience with US organizations is strongly preferred.



Headset, computer, quiet workspace, reliable internet, comfort with Google Sheets, Gmail, and Calendar.



Willingness to sign a confidentiality agreement. You will handle professional contact information only, never resident information.



Terms

This is a long term role and we expect hours to grow as the network grows. Keeping other clients is fine as long as your calling blocks are protected.



How to apply

Subject line: Outreach VA + [your city] + VILLAGE



Answer in your own words: Describe a time you contacted an organization and had to find the right person to speak with. What did you actually say? And why would a social worker want to hear from a housing provider? Do you have any suggestions for the implementation or strategy? Can you list a few past projects that are very similar to this project? What challenges do you see in this project?

title: DTC Creative Strategist
description:
We operate a fast-growing portfolio of digitally native consumer brands: our flagship brand Zoyava, in health and wellness supplements, and our sister brands in skincare and hair oils. We sell across Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, DTC, and nationwide retail, with a steady pipeline of new product launches across all four brands. Our dedication to unparalleled quality and exceptional customer experience drives our operations, and we believe every employee's contribution is indispensable to our success.



Why This Role Exists



Paid social creative is the single biggest lever in scaling our products. Every new product we launch has one target: $1 million per month in revenue. We are hiring the person who owns the creative engine that gets each launch there. You will drive growth across all four brands and every new product in the pipeline — turning customer data, reviews, and market research into a relentless weekly stream of high-converting ad concepts across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube. You will not be the editor or the media buyer, but you will own the strategy that connects them: identifying winning angles, writing sharp briefs, directing creators and editors, and reading performance data to d
 what to scale, kill, or iterate.



What Success Looks Like in 12 Months



Every new product launch across Zoyava and our family of brands, ships with a full creative testing system from day one, and is on a measurable trajectory toward $1M/month.

Creative win rate (ads that beat account-average CPA/ROAS) improves quarter over quarter, with learnings documented in a living angle/hook library per brand and per product.

The creative pipeline never runs dry: media buyers across all four brands always have fresh, on-brand creative to test and scale.

Winning concepts are directly attributable to revenue, because your compensation depends on it.

Weekly Output Expectations

This is a high-volume, high-velocity role covering a four-brand portfolio, prioritized by the new product launch calendar. 



Steady-state expectations:



15–20 net-new ad concepts per week across the portfolio, weighted toward active and upcoming product launches, each grounded in a specific angle, audience insight, hook, and offer.

40–60 launched creative variations per week shipped through editors and UGC creators — new concepts plus iterations of proven winners.

12–15 detailed creative briefs per week for video editors, UGC creators, and designers, with hooks, scripts/outlines, references, and success criteria.

Launch sprints for every new product: a dedicated 20+ concept testing wave in the first 30 days of each launch to find scalable winners fast.

1 weekly creative performance review per brand: what won, what lost, why, and what the next testing sprint looks like.

24–48 hour feedback turnaround on all drafts to keep the production pipeline moving.



Key Responsibilities: 



Creative Strategy & Concepting

Own paid social creative strategy for all four brands — across Meta, TikTok, Snap, YouTube, and other DTC channels.

Own the creative side of every new product launch: positioning angles, launch hooks, offers, and the first-30-day testing wave.

Mine customer reviews, support tickets, competitor ads, and market trends to identify winning angles, hooks, and offers per brand and per product.

Build and maintain a rolling 4-week testing roadmap per brand, re-prioritized weekly around the launch calendar.

Maintain a swipe file and creative reference library of top-performing ads in supplements, skincare, haircare, and adjacent categories.



Briefing & Production Management



Write detailed, unambiguous creative briefs for video editors, UGC creators, and designers.

Source, brief, and direct UGC creators and influencers to produce authentic, conversion-focused, compliant content.

Manage the production pipeline to hit the weekly output targets above with fast turnaround and consistent quality.



Performance Analysis & Iteration



Partner with media buyers to track CTR, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, hold rate, and thumb-stop rate by concept, angle, brand, and product.

Run a weekly scale/kill/iterate decision cadence and feed learnings directly into the next round of concepts.

Report creative performance, testing learnings, and revenue attribution of winning concepts to leadership on a weekly cadence.



Brand, Compliance & Collaboration



Keep all creative on-voice and on-brand for each of the four brands, adapted to each platform's native format.

Ensure ad compliance across supplements (health claims) and beauty/personal care (cosmetic claims) on every concept and brief.

Align creative with each brand's marketing calendar, promotions, and product launch schedule.



Required Qualifications



3+ years working strictly in creative strategy or creative direction for paid social — this is not an editor, media buyer, or generalist marketing role.

That experience must be with CPG or telehealth brands (supplements, health & wellness, beauty, or personal care strongly preferred).

Proven track record of concepting ads that drove measurable revenue — you will be asked to show 3–5 ads with the numbers (spend, CPA/ROAS, run time) and your hypothesis behind each.

Demonstrated ability to sustain a high-volume, multi-brand pipeline (15+ concepts/week) without sacrificing quality.

Experience supporting new product launches, not just scaling established products.

Strong command of Meta and TikTok ad formats, native best practices, and DTC customer psychology (hooks, angles, offers, awareness levels).

Fluent reading of paid social performance data to guide creative decisions.

Experience writing briefs and directing video editors and UGC creators.

Excellent written and verbal English; strong project management across a multi-brand pipeline.

Based in the Philippines with reliable internet; able to maintain at least 3–4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time for standups and media buyer syncs.

Comfortable with — and motivated by — a fully performance-based, independent contractor engagement. Your upside is uncapped and tied directly to the revenue your winning concepts generate.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with an omni-channel brand selling across Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and DTC.

Experience running creative for multiple brands or a brand portfolio simultaneously.

Familiarity with Motion, Foreplay, or similar creative analytics/inspiration tools.

Working knowledge of ad compliance requirements for supplements, health claims, and cosmetics.

Basic hands-on ability with editing or design tools (a plus, not a requirement).



Compensation & What We Offer



100% performance-based compensation: you earn 5% of ad spend attributable to winning creative concepts, paid monthly. A "winning concept" and its attribution methodology are defined in writing before your first sprint.

Uncapped upside: a single concept that scales a product toward $1M/month pays accordingly. There is no ceiling on what a top performer earns here.

Independent contractor engagement: full-time-equivalent commitment, invoiced monthly under a contractor agreement — you own your schedule outside required team overlap hours.

A dynamic, fast-growing four-brand portfolio with real ownership of the creative engine.

Career growth into a Creative Director / Head of Creative Strategy seat as the portfolio scales.



How to Apply



Send your resume plus: (1) 3–5 of your best-performing ads with the numbers (spend, CPA or ROAS, how long they ran) and the hypothesis behind each, and (2) a short note or 1-minute Loom on how you would structure the first 30 days of creative testing for a new supplement launch targeting $1M/month. 



Applications without performance examples will not be reviewed.

HMO

Career growth opportunities within a rapidly growing omni-channel CPG company

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

, website, and social media to keep messaging aligned

 automation skills first. But if you write well and understand content marketing too, that is a genuine advantage.

________________________________________

THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Beyond skills and experience, these are the qualities that matter to our team:

• Highly organised with files, documents, and digital records — student information and marketing assets are accurately maintained and easy to find

• Responsive and proactive: you provide timely updates to prospective students and the team during business hours, without needing to be asked

• Strong attention to detail —
 campaigns, CRM records, and student communications are always accurate and professional

• Someone who takes genuine pride in the quality of their work and the impact it has on people's lives

________________________________________

HOURS & FLEXIBILITY

Our published UK office hours are 7:00am–12:00 noon GMT/BST. For Philippines-based team members, this translates to approximately 2:00pm–7:00pm (BST, April–October) or 3:00pm–8:00pm (GMT, November–March) — a normal working afternoon.

That said, we are genuinely flexible. We care about coverage and results, not clock-watching. If an earlier start works better for you — allowing you to overlap more naturally with colleagues and cover enquiries across multiple time zones — we are open to that conversation. What matters is that prospective students receive warm, prompt responses and that enrolment conversations are scheduled effectively. We do not expect our team to work weekends. However, any enquiry or question that arrives over the weekend must be responded to on Monday morning — this is a non-negotiable standard of care for our prospective students.

________________________________________

INTERNATIONAL COVERAGE — WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOU

While we are based in the UK, our programmes are internationally recognised and our current primary target market is Australia — alongside students in the UK, Europe, and North America. This means prospective students may be enquiring from multiple time zones throughout the day.

You will not be navigating this alone. Our Dean of Studies is based in Brisbane, Australia, and serves as the primary point of contact for student interviews — particularly for Australian prospective students — while you are onboarding and finding your feet. title: California Workers’ Compensation Legal Administrative Assistant / Deposition Coordinator
description:
We are a growing, high-volume California workers’ compensation defense law firm seeking a highly organized, experienced Legal Administrative Assistant / Deposition Coordinator to join our team.



This position is focused on deposition scheduling, legal calendaring, notices, follow-up, case support, and administrative coordination for a busy California workers’ compensation defense practice.



Prior California workers’ compensation experience is strongly preferred.



Responsibilities



Responsibilities may include:



* Scheduling applicant depositions

* Coordinating deposition dates with applicant attorneys and defense attorneys

* Scheduling court reporters

* Scheduling interpreters

* Preparing and sending deposition notices

* Confirming depositions before the scheduled date

* Calendaring depositions, hearings, QME examinations, deadlines, and follow-up dates

* Coordinating QME / AME appointments and related administrative tasks

* Preparing and sending routine legal correspondence

* Following up with applicant attorneys, court reporters, interpreters, medical offices, and vendors

* Requesting and following up on medical records

* Tracking outstanding records, reports, correspondence, and responses

* Uploading and organizing documents in the case-management system

* Creating and completing administrative tasks

* Monitoring attorney calendars

* Monitoring cases for upcoming deadlines

* Assisting with WCAB / EAMS administrative tasks

* Helping ensure that assignments are completed from beginning to end

* Providing administrative support to attorneys and other members of the legal team



What We Are Looking For



We need someone who is:



* Extremely organized

* Detail-oriented

* Fast and efficient

* Reliable

* Excellent at follow-up

* Comfortable handling a high volume of tasks

* Able to prioritize urgent matters

* Proactive

* Comfortable working independently

* Strong in written English

* Professional in
 communications

* Able to manage multiple deadlines at once

* Comfortable communicating with attorneys, law firms, court reporters, interpreters, medical offices, and vendors



We are specifically looking for someone who takes ownership of assignments.



For example, if you are asked to schedule a deposition, we expect you to follow the assignment through from beginning to end, including obtaining dates, coordinating the parties, scheduling the court reporter and interpreter if necessary, preparing the notice, calendaring the deposition, confirming the deposition, and following up on anything outstanding.



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is highly preferred:



* California workers’ compensation

* Workers’ compensation defense

* WCAB

* EAMS

* Applicant depositions

* Deposition notices

* Court reporter scheduling

* Interpreter scheduling

* QME / PQME / AME scheduling

* Legal calendaring

* Medical record requests

* Subpoenaed records

* DORs

* MSCs

* Status Conferences

* Workers’ compensation hearings

* MerusCase



MerusCase experience is a major plus.



Candidates with strong U.S. litigation administrative experience may also be considered.



Schedule



This is a full-time, long-term position.



You must have:



* Reliable high-speed internet

* A reliable computer

* A quiet and professional work environment

* Strong written and spoken English



Availability overlapping with California / Pacific Time business hours is strongly preferred.



Compensation



Compensation will depend on experience, skills, and demonstrated knowledge of California workers’ compensation legal administration.



We are willing to pay more for a candidate who already understands California workers’ compensation procedures and can contribute with minimal training.



There is opportunity for increased responsibility and growth for the right person.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the words:



DEPOSITION COORDINATOR



Applications that do not begin with those words may not be reviewed.



Please answer all of the following questions:



1. How many years of legal administrative experience do you have?

2. Have you previously worked for a California law firm?

3. Have you previously worked on California workers’ compensation cases? If yes, please describe your experience.

4. Have you personally scheduled depositions before?

5. Have you prepared and sent deposition notices?

6. Have you scheduled court reporters?

7. Have you scheduled interpreters?

8. Have you scheduled QME, AME, or other medical-legal appointments?

9. Have you worked with WCAB or EAMS?

10. Have you used MerusCase? If yes, for how long?

11. What other legal case-management software have you used?

12. Approximately how many active cases or matters were you responsible for supporting at one time?

13. How do you keep track of multiple deadlines and follow-up tasks?

14. What hours are you available to work in Pacific Time?

15. Are you currently working for another employer or client? If yes, please describe your current work schedule.

16. What is your expected monthly salary in U.S. dollars?

17. Why did you leave, or why are you considering leaving, your most recent position?



Short Practical Question



An attorney sends you the following instruction:



“Please schedule the applicant’s deposition.”



You
 applicant’s attorney requesting available dates, but you do not receive a response.



In approximately 5–10 sentences, explain exactly what you would do next and how you would make sure the assignment does not get forgotten.



Please answer this question yourself. Do not use ChatGPT or another AI tool.



We are not looking for a perfect legal answer. We want to understand your actual experience, organization, judgment, and follow-through.



About the Firm



We are a growing California workers’ compensation defense law firm representing employers, insurance carriers, and claims professionals.



We operate in a fast-paced, high-volume environment and place a strong emphasis on organization, responsiveness, accountability, communication, and teamwork.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our team and take ownership of important administrative workflows.



If you are highly organized, experienced with legal scheduling and follow-up, and take pride in making sure nothing falls through the cracks, we would like to hear from you.



Please remember to begin your application with: DEPOSITION COORDINATOR
