title: Accounting Specialist
description:
Accounting Specialist

Location: Remote, Philippines

Schedule: Full-time with U.S. Eastern Time overlap

About the Role

We are hiring a dependable, detail-oriented Accounting Specialist to maintain accurate financial records and support the daily accounting needs of a growing United States business.

You will handle bookkeeping, reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, job costing, financial documentation, and monthly reporting. You will work primarily in QuickBooks Online and spreadsheets while coordinating with leadership, operations, customers, and vendors.

This is a hands-on role for someone who takes ownership of accuracy, investigates discrepancies, meets deadlines, and keeps financial information organized without repeated reminders.

What You Will Do

Record and categorize daily transactions in QuickBooks Online. Maintain an accurate chart of accounts, customer and vendor records, supporting documentation, and audit trails.

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, payment processors, loans, and other balance-sheet accounts. Identify missing transactions, duplicate entries, incorrect classifications, and unexplained differences, then resolve or document them.

Review vendor bills for accuracy, coding, approvals, and supporting documents. Prepare payment schedules, track due dates, reconcile vendor statements, and help prevent duplicate or late payments.

Create customer invoices, apply payments and credits, monitor accounts-receivable aging, and follow up professionally on overdue balances. Research discrepancies and keep customer records current.

Support job costing by assigning income, labor, materials, subcontractor costs, and expenses to the correct customer, project, location, or department. Help leadership understand job-level revenue, costs, and margins.

Assist with weekly and monthly close activities. Prepare reconciliation schedules, workpapers, adjusting-entry recommendations, and financial reports for review.

Assist with payroll preparation, contractor records, expense reimbursements, sales-tax documentation, year-end reporting, and requests from accountants or tax professionals. Final payroll and tax filings remain subject to authorized review.

Maintain organized records for invoices, receipts, statements, contracts, tax documents, and payment confirmations. Communicate clearly about missing documents, unusual transactions, overdue balances, upcoming payments, and issues requiring a decision.

Help improve accounting procedures, checklists, templates, and internal controls. Identify repetitive work that can be standardized or automated without weakening accuracy.

What We Are Looking For

You have at least two years of professional bookkeeping or accounting experience, including hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online.

You understand transaction coding, bank and credit-card reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, accrual and cash-basis accounting, general-ledger maintenance, and basic financial statements.

You can use Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for reconciliations, lookups, filters, formulas, data cleanup, and reporting.

You have experience supporting a United States business or U.S.-based clients and understand documentation, cutoff dates, monthly close deadlines, and consistent accounting processes.

You communicate professionally in written and spoken English. You can explain discrepancies, request missing information, and summarize financial issues clearly.

You demonstrate excellent attention to detail, sound judgment, and integrity. You protect confidential information, manage recurring deadlines, and communicate early when information is missing or work may be delayed.

You are based in the Philippines and can consistently overlap with United States Eastern Time business hours. You have a reliable computer, stable internet, a backup plan, and a professional remote workspace.

Preferred Experience

Experience with construction, home services, project-based businesses, franchise operations, or job-cost accounting is strongly preferred.

Experience with 
, Gusto, ADP, Stripe, payroll systems, receipt-management tools, or other cloud accounting platforms is helpful.

What Success Looks Like

Financial records remain accurate, current, and supported. Accounts are reconciled on schedule. Transactions are recorded correctly and assigned to the proper project or account.

Receivable and payable issues are identified early and followed through to resolution. Monthly reports are delivered on time and can be trusted by leadership.

This Role Is Not a Fit If

This position is not a fit if you leave reconciliations incomplete, make unsupported entries, ignore discrepancies, avoid following up for documentation, miss monthly deadlines, or depend on someone else to check routine work.

Working Arrangement

This is a full-time remote position for a Philippines-based independent professional. Substantial overlap with United States Eastern Time business hours is required.

Compensation will be based on experience, QuickBooks proficiency, U.S. accounting exposure, and demonstrated ability.

Please fill out this form

title: Video Editor for Wedding Tech Startup
description:
We're Foreverly, a US-based wedding tech startup building a platform that shows couples transparent wedding venue pricing. The founder also owns a wedding venue in Minnesota. We're creating content across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn to grow both the company brand and the founders' personal brands.



What You'll Be Doing



You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content. Each week we'll drop raw footage into a shared Google Drive folder. You turn that into finished, ready-to-post videos.



Some videos will be simple: a talking head clip that just needs captions, a clean cut, and a hook on screen. Others will be more involved — split-screen formats, screen recordings with voiceover, b-roll cuts, multi-clip story edits, trend-based formats, and more complex motion text. The mix will vary week to week.



Specifically, you'll handle:



Cutting raw footage into 15-90 second short-form videos

Adding auto-synced captions (styled to match current trending formats)

Text overlays, hooks on screen, lower thirds

Formatting and exporting for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn

Suggesting cuts, hooks, or improvements when you see opportunities (we value creative input)

Occasional thumbnail creation or static graphics for carousels



Volume



Up to 10 finished videos per week, typically closer to 6-8. The majority will be for the Foreverly company accounts, with some for the founders' personal accounts.



What We're Looking For



Strong portfolio of short-form content (TikTok/Reels style, NOT wedding cinematography or corporate video)

Experience editing for personal brands, founders, or creators

You know what performs on social right now — trending caption styles, pacing, hooks, transitions

Proficient in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar

Fast turnaround: 48 hours per batch

Reliable communication — we move fast and need someone who responds within a few hours on working days

Very strong English comprehension (all footage and direction will be in English)



Nice to Have (Not Required)



Experience with startup or business content

Basic motion graphics

Familiarity with wedding industry content



Schedule and Availability



This is an ongoing part-time role, roughly 10-15 hours per week depending on volume. We batch film once a week (usually Sunday or Monday US time) and need first edits back within 48 hours. Flexible on your working hours as long as deliverables are on time.



This is a long-term role. Volume may increase over time as we grow, and we'd want the right person to grow with it.



How to Apply



Please send:



A link to your portfolio or 3-5 examples of short-form videos you've edited (TikTok/Reels style)

A brief note about your editing tools and turnaround time

Your hourly or monthly rate expectation



We'll send top candidates a paid test edit with raw footage to see how you work before committing.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

title: Virtual Assistant — Digital Advertising Specialist (AI Agent Trainer)
description:
## About the Role



We run a portfolio of businesses operated largely by AI agents. We are hiring an experienced media buyer whose job is not to run our ad accounts manually — it is to **teach our AI agents how to run them**. You will document your knowledge as step-by-step processes (SOPs), train the agent through examples and feedback, review its campaign plans and decisions, and refine its instructions until it can create, launch, analyze, and continuously improve advertising on Google Ads and Meta 
 & Instagram) with minimal human input.



This is a role for someone who has spent real budgets and can explain *why* campaigns win or die, not just how to click through Ads Manager.



## What You'll Do



- Design the end-to-end advertising workflow (campaign setup ? tracking ? creative briefing & testing ? analysis ? optimization decisions) as clear, written SOPs an AI agent can follow

- Turn your optimization instincts into explicit decision rules with real thresholds: when to kill, scale, iterate, or wait

- Train the agent by reviewing its campaign plans, ad copy, creative briefs, and optimization decisions — approving, correcting, and explaining your reasoning

- Build pass/fail checklists for launches, tracking verification, and ad policy compliance on both platforms

- Monitor early campaign performance and translate learnings into updated agent instructions



## Required Experience



- 3+ years of hands-on media buying on BOTH Google Ads and Meta Ads with real budgets (be ready to state ranges)

- Deep knowledge of conversion tracking: pixel/tags, Google Tag Manager, Conversions API, event verification

- A structured creative testing methodology — not "post and pray"

- Fluency in the numbers: ROAS, CPA, CTR, frequency, CPM — and explicit rules for acting on them

- Knowledge of ad policies and what gets accounts restricted or banned on each platform

- Excellent written English — this role is mostly writing instructions and feedback

- Comfortable working with AI tools; you'll be teaching one



## Nice to Have



- Experience briefing or generating ad creatives with AI tools

- Experience recovering restricted ad accounts

- Experience writing SOPs or training junior media buyers



## How We Work



Remote and mostly async. You'll communicate in written English via chat and short documents. Flexible hours with some overlap for check-ins.



---



## Application Questionnaire (required)



Please answer all questions in English. Short, specific answers beat long generic ones.



1. Describe the largest ad account you've personally managed: platform(s), monthly budget range, vertical, your role, and results (ranges are fine, be specific about what YOU did).

2. Walk us through how you'd launch a campaign for a brand-new product on Meta, step by step — objectives, audiences, budget split, creative volume, and what you check on days 1, 3, and 7.

3. What exact metrics and thresholds do you use to d
 an ad should be killed vs. scaled? Give the real numbers you use.

4. Describe your conversion tracking setup: which tools, in what order, and how you verify events fire correctly before scaling spend.

5. Have you ever had an ad account restricted or banned (yours or a client's)? What happened and what did you change afterward?

6. Imagine you must teach a very literal-minded new employee to write Meta ad primary text. Write the exact rules you would give them (5–10 lines).

title: Short-Form Video Editor- (long-term partnership)
description:
Short-Form Video Editor – Fitness & Nutrition Content



About the Role



I’m a fitness coach and content creator looking for a reliable video editor to work with me on short-form fitness, nutrition and educational content for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.



I’m looking to test a few editors initially, with the goal of finding one person I can work with consistently long-term as my content output grows.



The editing itself isn’t extremely complicated or effects-heavy. I’m much more interested in someone who understands good pacing, storytelling and keeping the viewer’s attention.



The Content



Most videos will be fitness and nutrition based, including:



* Talking-head educational videos

* Food and high-protein product videos

* Exercise demonstrations

* Voiceover videos

* Gym/fitness content

* Videos using props to explain concepts

* B-roll-based educational videos

* Occasional lifestyle/fitness content



I will often provide the raw footage, voiceover, B-roll and direction. Your job is to turn those assets into a clean, engaging finished video.



Editing Style I’m Looking For



I want clean, modern short-form editing that supports what I’m saying.



This will usually include:



* Removing pauses and unnecessary sections

* Clean jump cuts

* Punch-in / punch-out zooms

* Emphasising important sentences or words

* On-screen captions/subtitles

* Good pacing and retention

* Adding B-roll where appropriate

* Matching B-roll to what I’m talking about

* Simple sound effects when they genuinely improve the video

* Music where appropriate

* Basic colour correction

* Creating a strong first 2–3 seconds

* Understanding when NOT to add effects



The most important thing is that the editing enhances the message rather than distracting from it.



What I’m Looking For



I’d ideally like someone who:



* Has experience editing Reels, TikToks or YouTube Shorts

* Understands short-form content and viewer retention

* Can follow references and recreate an editing style

* Communicates well

* Meets deadlines

* Is comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

* Has good attention to detail

* Wants consistent long-term work

* Ideally has some interest in fitness, nutrition or health content



You don’t need to be the world’s most advanced editor.



I’d rather have someone reliable, creative and willing to learn my style.



Workload



Initially, I’d like to start with a few videos as a trial.



If we’re a good fit, I’m looking to significantly increase my content output, so there is potential for consistent weekly work and a long-term position.



Some weeks may involve multiple short-form videos, and eventually I’d like an editor who understands my style well enough that I can send over footage with minimal instructions.



Paid Test Edit



For applicants I’m interested in, I’ll provide footage for a paid test edit.



I’ll give you:



* Raw footage

* Any relevant B-roll

* Voiceover if required

* Reference videos/style

* Basic direction



You’ll then create the finished short-form video.



I’m not expecting free work.



The purpose of the test is simply to see how you interpret the footage, pacing and overall content style before committing to ongoing work.



Payment



I’m open to discussing either:



* A rate per completed video, or

* A weekly/monthly arrangement once we’re working consistently.



The rate will depend on your experience, editing quality, turnaround time and the complexity of the video.



How to Apply



Please send me:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your experience editing short-form content.

3. 3 examples of your best short-form edits — please don’t send your entire portfolio.

4. Your usual price per 30–90 second short-form video.

5. Your typical turnaround time.

6. What editing software you use.

7. Your availability each week.



And finally, start your application with the word Infinite, so I know you’ve actually read the full job description.



I’m looking forward to finding someone I can build a long-term working relationship with.
